method: Complete bilingual reading of 365 gameplay texts, 80 contract/ambition texts and 300 event texts including all their branches; targeted cross-catalog range, direction, Renown and duration checks. Review reports distinguish complete readings from excerpts and remaining items.

root.scope: 365 gameplay/equipment/tooltip/retinue/state texts of at least 180 source characters, plus targeted range and Renown terminology checks.
root.method: Complete bilingual reading of each queued text and every contained random branch. Truncated rows 297-300 were reread separately. Supplemental range/term rows reviewed with their complete source and translation.
root.terminology_policy: Renown attribute = 声望; Reputation attribute = 声誉. General narrative synonyms remain where natural.

method: 按队列索引 0–79 顺序完整阅读英文原文、现有中文及所有随机分支，逐段对照语义、指代、语气、增删义与中文搭配。
以 8 条以内的小批次输出；进入较长的委托随机文本后缩至 4 条。对候选改动重读整条上下文，不以关键词命中替代逐句阅读。
只建议确认有改善的局部改写，不改剧情、人设、难度、数量或变量值；保留大多数条目原译。
只读官方 data_001.dat 的 barbarian_king_contract.cnut、big_game_hunt_contract.cnut、strings.cnut，确认方向、距离和地形变量的来源及中文值。
全部建议通过 core.l10n_tokens.validate_translation；同时核对主词库中 key、source 和 before 仍与队列快照一致。

composed_fixture_cases.expected: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]一群难民与战团擦肩而过。传闻四起，说蛮族之王在北方，离这里有一段路。路上的许多人都来自石桥镇，显然不愿留在原地，等那片蛮族的人潮压过来。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]一个推着空货车的商人与战团相遇。他虽已无货可卖，却告诉你，路上都在传，有个野蛮人自称国王。按他的说法，那家伙就在你们北方的黑森林一带。他朝你们要走的方向点点头。%SPEECH_ON%如果非要往那边去，就给那些蛮子狠狠吃些苦头。他们活该。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]一个半裸男人盘腿坐在路旁。他说，有个野蛮人带着军队烧了他的农庄，凌辱了女人，杀光了男人。%SPEECH_ON%我躲在一堆灌木里，双手捂住嘴，才捡回一条命。%SPEECH_OFF%男人擦了擦鼻子。%SPEECH_ON%我看见你们带着武器。若是来找那个野蛮人的，我倒能告诉你：他们似乎朝北方的黑森林去了，就在森林，离这儿有一段路。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]你发现一座小村落被烧毁的残骸。几个幸存者仍徘徊其间，身影与废墟上飘起的烟雾一样虚无。有人说，一个摆着国王架势的男人来了，逮到谁就杀谁，随后往北去了。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]你一路遇见许多翻倒的小货车和燃烧的货车。车里空空如也，货物尽失，只剩主人的尸体。几个孩子正在其中一处残骸里翻找。你问是谁干的，一个胆大的男孩开口。%SPEECH_ON%北边来的蛮子，不过现在往北去了。我看见他们了。他们在森林，我猜离这儿有一段路。%SPEECH_OFF%他抠了抠鼻子。%SPEECH_ON%对了，他们杀人。看着跟你们有点像，不过块头更大，八成也更强壮。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]埃德蒙德大人的一名斥候在路上找到你。他报告说，蛮族之王在北方的黑森林一带出没，就在森林，离这里有一段路。你问斥候要不要加入这场战斗，男人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不了，大人，我现在就挺好。四处跑跑，看看动静，回来报信，空闲时再找一两个婊子。这日子够好了，可不想让你们佣兵的活法把它毁了！%SPEECH_OFF%倒也在理。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]奥托最先发现了痕迹：小规模交战的残迹、烧焦的尸体、渐淡的脚印，还有车辙。痕迹如此之多，显然有一支军队从这里经过。%SPEECH_ON%团长，看样子他们打完以后，往北去了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

parts.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{You enter %employer%'s room. The man is picking his fingers with a peacock feather, wagging its colors around on one end while fishing out grime with the other. He talks rather dismissively to your presence.%SPEECH_ON%My guards have already informed that you are interested in a beast hunt and I'm quite glad that you are. The pay will be per head. Smaller beasts, webknechts, corpse eating things, the sort I'm sure are of no trouble to you, but which the fellow locals are too scared to confront. If you're as good at your job as folks seem to say, then you shouldn't dally jumping on this offer. Rid my lands of these. To start with, there's been sightings in the region of %worldmapregion% %distance% %direction% of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you into his room. He takes a scroll the town crier had given you while walking through the markets earlier.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, you're here for the beast hunt then. I thought you were entertainment of a...%SPEECH_OFF%He pinches the side of your shirt and tilts a smile.%SPEECH_ON%Different sort. Well, nonetheless, beasts are ravaging the countryside and I'd happily pay you a tidy sum to take care of them. The pay will be per head, of course, giving you a wealth of riches to earn if you keep that blade of yours slick. If you need a place to start your hunt, travel to the region of %worldmapregion% %distance% %direction% of here. There you'll find an assortment of large eight-legged freaks and furry monsters. Whatever it is that would frighten a common farmer, nothing too scary for you though, you big man you.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% with his bootless feet up on a table, a throng of women pruning them. They thumb plugs of thickened dirt from between his toes like the birth rites of some imago monstrosity. You clear your throat. The man clears his throat in a startled return.%SPEECH_ON%Ah yes, the sellsword. Here, I've a task for you if you are interested.%SPEECH_OFF%He dismissively throws a scroll at your feet which lists a need for beast slaying. Webknechts. Slender wolves. Nothing too frightening. A note on the map points to the nearby region of %worldmapregion% to the %direction%. The man belches.%SPEECH_ON%The pay is per head, hope that suits you well.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% turning a helve in hand. The demarcation between handle and where the blade should have been is clearly splintered, showing a decisive end to the weapon's use. The man throws it on his table and claps sawdust off his palms.%SPEECH_ON%Beasts are roaming these parts and I need someone of your stock to slay them all. What say you, hm? The pay will be by the head. To start your hunt, head to the region of %worldmapregion% to the %direction%. All manner of lesser beasts are being a nuisance there.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you to his room. His table is covered in scrolls, each with drawings of animals and beasts and possibly even monsters. He's jawing on some berries, spitting juice as he talks.%SPEECH_ON%Locals say there are foul things afoot, though not a one will give me a proper description as to what it is the trouble. Something about monstrous wolves or eight-legged monsters. I can hardly stand around and do nothing so that's why I'm requesting your services. Head to the fief of %worldmapregion% %distance% %direction%. If you see any beasts then slay them where they stand and take their heads. I'll pay by the scalp.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% meets you while in congress with a group of farmers. He states that supposed monsters are tearing the hinterland to pieces. A farmer pipes up.%SPEECH_ON%Beasts, the lot of them. Wolves that walk on their hindlegs, spiders yea big, corpse eating things that stink of scum.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman waves his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, yes, that's enough. Sellsword, I need you to go to head out and hunt these creatures down. Start by travelling to the region of %worldmapregion% to the %direction% of here and see to it that any beasts afoot are put to the earth. But do be sure to bring back their heads, I'll be paying you for each. That is, if you're interested of course.%SPEECH_OFF%}

composed_fixture_cases.expected: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{你走进雷纳大人的房间。男人拿着一根孔雀羽毛剔指甲，一端的彩羽晃来晃去，另一端则挑着污垢。他说话时，对你颇不在意。%SPEECH_ON%卫兵已经告诉我，你对狩猎野兽有兴趣，我很高兴。报酬按头算。都是些小点的野兽，巨蛛、吃尸体的东西之类，想必难不倒你，本地人却吓得不敢面对。你若真像传闻那样有本事，就该立刻接下这份差事。替我的领地清掉它们。先从阴影丘陵一带找起，在东北方，距此很近，那里有人见过。%SPEECH_OFF% | 雷纳大人欢迎你进屋，接过你先前逛市场时，从传令员手里拿到的卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%啊，原来是为狩猎来的。我还以为，你是来提供某种……%SPEECH_OFF%他捏起你的衣角，歪嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%别样的消遣。不过，无妨。野兽正在乡间肆虐，我很乐意出一笔好价钱，请你收拾它们。当然，按头计酬。只要你的刀够勤快，就有大把财富可赚。不知道从哪儿开始的话，就去阴影丘陵一带，东北边，距此很近。那里有各种硕大的八条腿怪物，还有毛茸茸的恶兽。总之，是能吓坏普通农夫的东西。可你这么个大男人，当然不会怕。%SPEECH_OFF% | 雷纳大人脱了靴子，将双脚搁在桌上，一群女人正替他清理。她们用拇指从趾缝间挤出一坨坨厚重污垢，仿佛在给什么怪虫接生。你清了清嗓子。男人一惊，也跟着清嗓。%SPEECH_ON%啊，对，佣兵。这里有桩差事，看你有没有兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF%他随手将卷轴扔到你脚边，上面列着需要剿杀的野兽：巨蛛，瘦长的狼，没什么太可怕的。地图上的标记指向附近东北边的阴影丘陵。男人打了个嗝。%SPEECH_ON%按头付钱，希望你满意。%SPEECH_OFF% | 雷纳大人正转着一根兵器柄。柄身与原本刃部相接的地方已经断裂，木刺参差，足见这件兵器再也用不了了。他将它扔到桌上，拍去掌心木屑。%SPEECH_ON%这一带有野兽横行，我需要你这种人把它们全杀了。怎么样？按头付钱。先往东北边的阴影丘陵一带找，那里各种小兽都在惹麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF% | 雷纳大人欢迎你进屋。桌上铺满卷轴，画着各种动物、野兽，也许还有怪物。他正嚼着浆果，一开口就喷果汁。%SPEECH_ON%本地人都说有恶兽出没，可没一个能像样地说明白，到底是什么麻烦。好像是怪狼，或是什么八条腿的怪物。我总不能干站着什么也不做，所以才请你来。去阴影丘陵那片领地，东北边，距此很近。看见野兽，就当场杀掉，取下脑袋。我按头皮付钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | 雷纳大人与一群农民议事时，接见了你。他说，有些所谓的怪物正将郊野搅得天翻地覆。一个农民插嘴道：%SPEECH_ON%全是恶兽。拿后腿走路的狼，这么大的蜘蛛，还有臭烘烘、吃尸体的东西。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族挥挥手。%SPEECH_ON%是，是，够了。佣兵，我要你出发，猎杀这些东西。先去这里东北边的阴影丘陵一带，把游荡的野兽都放倒。不过，务必带回脑袋，每颗我都付钱。当然，得看你有没有兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: Made of thick metal plates and mail, this heavy ancient armor still offers great protection after countless years. It's crusted and rotten in parts, however, severely limiting the mobility of the wearer.
changes.before: 这副古代重甲由厚钢板与锁甲构成，历经漫长岁月，防护依然出色。只是部分甲片结垢、衬料腐坏，严重妨碍穿戴者活动。
changes.after: 这副古代重甲由厚重的金属甲片与锁甲构成，历经漫长岁月，防护依然出色。只是部分地方已经结垢腐朽，严重妨碍穿戴者活动。
changes.reason: metal 未指定钢铁，腐朽部位也未指定为衬料；去掉擅自增加的材料与部位。

changes.source: The Glimpse of Davkul is a gift bestowed upon man by ancient and dark powers, a helmet merged with human skin and bones through the most unspeakable of rituals. A glimpse of a future where man shall become one with creations from a realm beyond. It shall never break, but instead keep regrowing its scarred skin on the spot.
changes.before: “达夫库尔一瞥”是古老黑暗力量赐给人类的礼物：通过难以启齿的仪式，头盔与人的皮肉、骨骼融为一体。它让人窥见一种未来——人类终将与异界的造物合而为一。它永不破碎，伤痕累累的皮肤总会当即重新生长。
changes.after: “达夫库尔一瞥”是古老黑暗力量赐给人类的礼物：通过骇人听闻的仪式，头盔与人的皮肉、骨骼融为一体。它让人窥见一种未来——人类终将与异界的造物合而为一。它永不破碎，伤痕累累的皮肤总会当即重新生长。
changes.reason: unspeakable 在黑暗献祭语境中强调恐怖骇人，而非羞于启齿。

changes.source: Held within this vial is a powerful sedative that will induce a deep sleep, unbreakable by pain. This is needed to keep the subject under long enough to graft another row of ribs, the bones themselves recovered from one of the Lorekeeper's more ordinary phylacteries.
changes.before: 这支小瓶里装着强效镇静剂，能令人陷入连疼痛都无法唤醒的沉睡。只有这样，才能让受试者长时间保持安静，以便移植另一副肋骨——骨头取自典籍守护者某个较普通的命匣。
changes.after: 这支小瓶里装着强效镇静剂，能令人陷入连疼痛都无法唤醒的沉睡。只有这样，才能让受试者长时间保持昏睡，以便额外移植一排肋骨——骨头取自典籍守护者某个较普通的命匣。
changes.reason: keep the subject under 指维持昏睡状态；another row 是额外一排肋骨，不是替换另一整副。

changes.source: Traded for with a malevolent witch at the expense of another man's life, this mysterious concoction promises to be a magical drink for the spirit, and to grant wisdom and insight as if having fought a dozen battles.
changes.before: 以另一个人的性命为代价，从邪恶女巫手中换来的神秘药液。据说它能施展滋养精神的魔法，赋予饮用者智慧与洞察，仿佛亲身经历过十多场战斗。
changes.after: 以另一个人的性命为代价，从邪恶女巫手中换来的神秘药液。据说它能施展滋养精神的魔法，赋予饮用者智慧与洞察，仿佛亲身经历过十二场战斗。
changes.reason: a dozen 为十二，不是泛指十多。

changes.source: The crepuscular sword bends purples and oranges until it seemingly carries twilight itself in its fuller. Held to the touch, one cannot tell if they are being burned or chilled. Magic or well-crafted, whatever the weapon is it vibrates as though it were fighting off power immense and you need only swing it to find the steel's true charge.
changes.before: 这柄长剑上流转着紫色与橙色的光晕，仿佛将暮色本身收进了剑身的血槽。握住它时，你甚至分不清掌心传来的是灼热还是寒意。无论源于魔法还是非凡的锻造技艺，剑身始终微微震颤，仿佛正压制着一股庞大的力量。只需挥剑，便能知晓这钢铁中究竟蕴藏着什么。
changes.after: 这柄长剑上流转着紫色与橙色的光晕，仿佛将暮色本身收进了剑身的凹槽。握住它时，你甚至分不清掌心传来的是灼热还是寒意。无论源于魔法还是非凡的锻造技艺，剑身始终微微震颤，仿佛正压制着一股庞大的力量。只需挥剑，便能知晓这钢铁中究竟蕴藏着什么。
changes.reason: fuller 是剑身凹槽；采用直观而不暗示排血用途的中文。

changes.source: The Drill Sergeant was a mercenary once, but an injury ended his career prematurely. Now he drills discipline into your men and yells a lot to make sure that everyone learns from their mistakes.

changes.after: 训练教官曾是一名佣兵，却因伤提前结束了战斗生涯。如今，他严加操练，让弟兄们牢记纪律，整日大声训斥，确保每个人都能从错误中长记性。

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]At the behest of %winninghouse%, the %companyname% confronted the armored ranks of the other houses, a seemingly insurmountable challenge. It was a hard fought struggle, against opponents trained, disciplined, and well equipped, but in the end you overcame the enemies of %winninghouse% and triumphed on its behalf.

During the celebrations that follow, %randomnoble%, one of the lesser members of %winninghouse%, suggests that you end the festivities early. Your men are getting too rowdy, and he's concerned they may take advantage of his family's hospitality, walking off with the silver plate or fighting with the staff. He notes that there has already been a broken window and points towards some broken glass on the floor.

You reply that although %winninghouse% was victorious, it is also at this point much weaker and more vulnerable than ever. Now would be a foolish time to alienate friends... or to make new enemies.

He takes your advice to heart and the celebration continues until dawn.
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_65.png[/img]受%winninghouse%之托，%companyname%迎战其他家族的重甲军阵，这曾是个看似不可能完成的任务。对手训练有素、纪律严明、装备精良，战斗艰苦至极。不过最终，你们还是击败了%winninghouse%的敌人，为它赢得胜利。

随后的庆功宴上，%winninghouse%的一位旁支成员%randomnoble%劝你提早散席。你的弟兄们闹得太凶，他担心众人得寸进尺，顺走家中的银盘，或与仆役打架。他说已经有人砸碎了窗户，还指了指地上的碎玻璃。

你回答说，%winninghouse%虽是胜者，此时却也比以往更加虚弱，更易遭人趁虚而入。眼下疏远朋友……或是再树新敌，可不是什么明智之举。

他认真听进了这番劝告，于是宴会一直持续到天亮。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]With the %recently_destroyed% still smouldering in your wake, a group of people come out from their hiding place in a nearby copse of trees where they had been watching the battle from afar. An old woman approaches you.%SPEECH_ON%Those green-skinned fiends drove us from our farm outside %nearesttown%, but thanks to you stalwart fellows we will prosper again. This is for you.%SPEECH_OFF%She proffers a bag of apples. Though it isn't much of a reward, the sentiment will be repeated again and again as word spreads of the orcs' destruction. %highestexperience_brother% barks out a laugh and bites into one of the juicy apples.%SPEECH_ON%With orcs, the big ones are too slow, and the young ones too stupid. Strategy overcomes brute force every time. The great green beasts depend on fear to do their work for them. Stand fast and they can be beat like anyone else!%SPEECH_OFF%The peasants marvel at %highestexperience_brother%'s speech, and prowess, and strength, clapping their hands, showering him with compliments and patting him on the back. While certainly true words, this is hardly the audience that should put his advice to use. You lay your hand on %highestexperience_brother%'s shoulder, as if to say to drop it a notch, lest any of the peasants think themselves heroes next time they spot a greenskin.
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_81.png[/img]%recently_destroyed%的余烬还在你们身后冒烟，一群人便从附近的小树林里走出来。他们一直藏在那里，远远望着这场战斗。一个老妇人来到你面前。%SPEECH_ON%那些绿皮恶鬼把我们赶出了%nearesttown%外的农场。多亏你们这些英勇的好汉，我们总算能重新过上好日子。这是给你们的。%SPEECH_OFF%她递上一袋苹果。礼物虽不丰厚，可随着兽人败亡的消息传开，这样的感激还会一次次出现。%highestexperience_brother%放声大笑，咬了一口多汁的苹果。%SPEECH_ON%兽人嘛，大个的太慢，小个的太蠢。打仗靠脑子，蛮力哪次赢得了谋略？那些绿皮大畜生就指望把人吓破胆。站稳了，它们跟别人一样能被打趴下！%SPEECH_OFF%农夫们惊叹于%highestexperience_brother%的豪言、武艺和力量，拍着手，夸个不停，还纷纷上前拍他的背。这话固然没错，可眼前这些人实在不该拿去照做。你将手搭在%highestexperience_brother%肩上，示意他收着点，免得哪个农夫下回见着绿皮，真把自己当成英雄。

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]When the miner find a diamond in the mountains, it is hurried away to the royal chambers. When the fisherman hauls the fattest catch of the day, a nobleman will have it himself. Good soldiers? To the lords as generals or trainers. Talented tailors? The finest fineries require the finest fingers, to the nobles he goes to serve. Houndmaster shows a bit of skill beyond bopping noses and barking commands? He can train wardogs for the highborn armies. So it is that this world snatches the talented as fast as the hawk pounces the rabbit which reveals itself.

 But now you've your own catch: %star%. He is a genuine talent, showing remarkable aptitude in physicality, martial skills, and courage. Even the rest of the %companyname% can sense the man's presence as sure as one sense destiny and greatness. %star% is everything you'd want in a mercenary, and were the company fitted entirely with a man of his mold, well, you'd do more than chase contracts, you'd conquer the whole world!
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]矿工在山里挖到钻石，转眼就被送进王室的厅堂。渔夫捕到当天最肥的鱼，贵族必会留给自己享用。好士兵？送到领主身边，当将领或教官。巧手裁缝？最华贵的衣裳要最灵巧的双手，也得去侍候贵族。驯犬师若除了敲鼻子、吼命令，还多会几招，便能替贵族军队训练战犬。这世界攫取人才，快得就像苍鹰扑向刚露头的兔子。

可如今，你也有了自己的收获：%star%。他确是难得的人才，体魄、武艺与胆气都显出非凡天赋。%companyname%的其他弟兄也能感到他的不凡，仿佛命运与伟业已经近在眼前。%star%具备你对佣兵的一切期望。倘若全团都是这样的人，你们哪还用四处找委托，早就去征服整个世界了！

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]After weeks spent listening for rumors, buying pints of beer for decrepit old veterans, and negotiating with wheedling crones, you were able to ferret out the locations of a prestigious weapon, shield, armor and helmet. Having learned where to find the pieces, all that remained was the minor matter of defeating the various horrors and cutthroats guarding it. Now soon to be worn by the men of your company, the pieces form a set fearsome to behold. %SPEECH_ON%The man who dons this arming onto the battlefield will see the fiercest enemy hobble away shaking a load down the leg of his pants!%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% exclaims proudly and to the laughing approval of his brothers in arms. You only hope their joy and excitement doesn't turn into envy once you announce which man will get to wear the pieces.
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_82.png[/img]数周以来，你四处打听消息，请年迈的老兵喝酒，与油嘴滑舌的老妇人周旋，终于查出了一套名器武器、盾牌、护甲和头盔的下落。知道东西在哪儿以后，剩下的不过是一桩“小事”：打败看守它们的各种怪物与亡命徒。如今，这套装备即将披在弟兄们身上，光是摆在一起，就足以令人胆寒。%SPEECH_ON%谁穿这一身上阵，再凶的敌人也得吓得一边瘸着逃，一边把屎顺裤腿抖出来！%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%得意地叫道，引得袍泽们大笑附和。你只盼着，等宣布由谁穿戴之后，这份欢喜和兴奋别转眼变成嫉妒。

changes.reason: 修复「一套名器武器」的名词堆叠，保留四类装备齐全及追查其下落的原意。

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]For many days you speak with potential recruits from different backgrounds and from every corner of society, weeding out the incompetent and haggling with the greedy. It seems as if in troubled times every vagrant, daytaler and nobleman's youngest son wishes to become a mercenary.

The men are glad for the company's bigger roster, and those you rejected will be the butt of many jests for weeks to come. %highestexperience_brother% claps you on the shoulder.%SPEECH_ON%How about that man who said he'd taken the heads of a bunch of orcs, but was really a baker from %randomtown%! Pinching flabby biceps and beating farmers' sons with tree branches was good sport for the first few days but by the end it was more work than chasing brigands around, if you ask me.%SPEECH_OFF%You now have twenty men under your command. Not all are veterans, and not all have been tested, but being able to rotate out your wounded will mean fresher units in the field.
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_80.png[/img]连日来，你接见了出身各异、来自社会各处的应征者，淘汰没本事的，与贪心的讨价还价。乱世之中，似乎每个流浪汉、短工，乃至贵族家不受重视的小儿子，都想来当佣兵。

战团人丁兴旺，弟兄们也很高兴，那些被你拒之门外的人，往后几周还会不断成为笑料。%highestexperience_brother%拍了拍你的肩。%SPEECH_ON%还记得那个吹嘘砍过一堆兽人脑袋的家伙吗？其实就是%randomtown%的面包师！捏捏松垮的胳膊，用树枝教训教训农家小子，头几天还挺好玩，可到了最后，依我看，比到处追山贼还累。%SPEECH_OFF%如今，你麾下已有二十人。并非人人都是老兵，也并非个个经受过考验，但能把伤员轮换下来，就意味着上场的人能有更充沛的精力。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]You soon discover that the wanderlust of which the skalds sing is not as widespread as they say. Your decision for the band to broaden its horizons is met with grumbling about forced marches and nights on the road. But not all join in the lamenting.%SPEECH_ON%If a day's march or a night spent in the rain wears you down, how will you face an orc charge?%SPEECH_OFF%%sergeantbrother% asks the men, only to get a snappish reply.%SPEECH_ON%Dry and alert.%SPEECH_OFF%You cracked the whip though and forced them to it. At each village and town, you encouraged the men to make themselves known, and they take this request to heart, getting in brawls, passing out in the town square, threatening the merchants, and harassing the settlement's daughters. Whatever the poor tradesmen and farmers think of the company, at least they won't soon forget you! Having traveled to the edges of your map, the name '%companyname%' is more widely known, and you earned a better understanding of the land.
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_16.png[/img]你很快就发现，吟游诗人歌咏的远游之志，远没有他们唱的那样深入人心。你决定带战团出去长长见识，换来的却是一片抱怨：赶路太急，露宿太苦。不过，也不是人人都跟着牢骚。%SPEECH_ON%走上一天路，或者淋一夜雨，就把你们折腾成这样，那兽人冲过来的时候，你们打算怎么应付？%SPEECH_OFF%%sergeantbrother%质问众人，立刻有人没好气地回嘴。%SPEECH_ON%先把衣服弄干，再打起精神应付。%SPEECH_OFF%你索性拿出团长的威严，赶着他们上路。每到一个村镇，你都鼓励弟兄们让当地人认识认识自己。他们倒真把这话听进去了：打架斗殴，醉倒在广场上，威吓商贩，纠缠姑娘。不管那些可怜的商人和农夫作何感想，至少短时间内，他们是忘不了你们了！如今，地图边缘的地方你们也走遍了，%companyname%的名号传得更远，你对这片土地也多了几分了解。

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]Introducing a new regimen to train the brothers in mastering a weapon is good for everyone's morale. Those who do the training improve their prowess and chances of survival, and earn the admiration of their companions, while the others have something fun to watch while sitting on a log and stuffing their faces with mutton.

The trainees practice in every spare moment with a variety of weapons until hard arms have become like oaken branches, and sharp eyes grow as keen and unforgiving as those of a great cat.%SPEECH_ON%Not only is %weaponbrother% a fearsome threat to our enemies, but his swift footwork makes you think of dancing girls.%SPEECH_OFF%%notweaponbrother% remarks, only to be soundly chastised with a training sword by %weaponbrother%.
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_50.png[/img]你为弟兄们定下新的训练规矩，让他们练熟手中的武器。这事对全团的士气都有好处：受训的人长了本事，多了几分活命的机会，还赢得了同伴的敬佩；其余人则能坐在圆木上，一边大嚼羊肉，一边看个热闹。

受训的弟兄一有空就操练各种兵器，原本结实的胳膊练得像橡木枝干，锐利的目光也变得像猛兽一般敏捷而冷酷。%SPEECH_ON%%weaponbrother%这家伙，杀起敌人来固然吓人，可那灵巧的小碎步，实在让人想起跳舞的姑娘。%SPEECH_OFF%%notweaponbrother%刚说完，就挨了%weaponbrother%一顿训练剑。

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{A man cannot thrive merely on skill and capability. Many know how to swing a sword, heft an axe, or loose an arrow. It is not in martial matters where man is molded, but within himself, within the corridors of his own heart. The steel forged there can't ever be defeated, for even a felled man of valor shall find himself eternal in the tomes of this world, celebrated in awe, and his name carried on the lips of those like him.

Now that the company has proven itself of the firmest element, it is ready to accept another Oath!}
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_180.png[/img]{人不能单凭技艺和本领立足于世。会挥剑、抡斧、射箭的人多得是。真正造就一个人的，并非武艺，而是他自己的内心。在心中锻出的钢铁永不会被击败：即使勇者倒下，也将永存于世间的史册，受后人敬仰传颂，让同道中人将他的名字铭记于口。

如今，战团已经证明了自身的坚韧，准备好接受新的誓言了！}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]{As you wait your turn, the crowd's bloodlust crawls through the dark, sheets of dust falling from above, the stomps of feet thunderous. They murmur in anticipation, and roar at killings. The quiet between battles is mere moments, and this silence is snatched away as the rusted gate lurches upward, chains rankling, the crowd abuzz once more. You step out into the light and so thunderous is the noise against your heart it could surely yet spur a dead man forth... | The arena's crowd is shoulder to shoulder, most blathering drunk. They scream and shout, their languages a mix of local and foreign, though the appeal to their bloodlust needs little articulation beyond their maddened faces and pumping fists. Now, the %companyname%'s men will satiate these mad fools... | Cleaners hurry about the arena. They drag away the bodies, collect what's worth collecting, and occasionally throw a trophy into the crowds, eliciting a moblike rendition of the arena's battles in the stands themselves. The %companyname% is now a part of this affair. | The arena awaits, the crowd alight, and the %companyname%'s turn to gain glory is at hand! | The crowd booms as the %companyname%'s men stride into its bloody pit. Despite the mindless bloodlust of the peoples, you can't help but feel a beat of pride in your chest, knowing that it is your company ready to put on a show. | The gate rises. Nothing is heard save the rattle of chains, the creak of pulleys, the grunts of slaves at work. When the men of the %companyname% step out of the arena's bowels they can hear the crunch of sand underfoot until they come to stand in the center of the pit. A strange voice screams from the tops of the stadium, some lost language beyond your knowing, but the words echo just once before the crowd erupts with cheers and roaring. Now is the time your men shall prove themselves before the watchful eye of the commoner. | The %companyname%'s business is rarely done before the eyes of those who would prefer themselves distantly separated from such violence. But in the arena, the commoner greedily awaits death and suffering, and it growls with bloodlust as your men enter the pits, and roars as the sellswords draw their weapons and ready for battle. | The arena is shaped like the pit of some sore, its ceiling torn away by the gods, revealing the vanity, bloodlust, and savagery of man. And it is man there, yelling and screaming, and if the blood sprays hit them, they wash their faces in the gore and grin at one another as though it were a joke. They fight one another for trophies and relish in the pain of others. And it is before these peoples that the %companyname% will fight, and for them they shall entertain and entertain well. | The arena's crowd is a mash of classes, rich and poor, for only the Viziers separate themselves out into stations above all. Briefly unified, the peoples of %townname% have graciously come together to watch men and monsters murder one another. With pleasure, the %companyname% seeks to do its part. | Boys sitting on the shoulders of fathers, young girls throwing flowers to the gladiators, women fanning themselves, men wondering if they could do it. These are the peoples of the arena - and the rest are all drunk out of their gourd and screaming nonsense. You hope the %companyname% can contribute to at least an hour or two to entertaining this mad lot. | The crowd roars as the %companyname%'s men step into the pit. One would be dumb to confuse excitement for desire, for as soon as the applause ends there is a smattering of empty beer mugs and rotten tomatoes and the general giggling delight of those watching the matter. You wonder if the %companyname%'s men are really best spent here, but then think hard on the gold and glory to be won, and that at the end of the day these mongrels in the stands will go home to their shit lives, and you'll go home to your shit life as well, but at least your pockets will be a bit deeper.}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_155.png[/img]{等候上场时，观众的嗜血狂热钻进了黑暗。头顶尘土簌簌而落，跺脚声轰鸣如雷。他们在期待中低语，又在杀戮时怒吼。两场战斗间的安静不过片刻，随即便被骤然升起的锈铁闸门打破。铁链哗啦作响，人群再次沸腾。你步入阳光，雷鸣般的声浪撞进胸膛，仿佛连死人都能被它催着向前…… | 竞技场的观众挤得肩挨着肩，大多喝得烂醉，满口胡话。他们尖叫呼喊，本地话与异乡话混杂在一起。不过，那些癫狂的脸和挥动的拳头，已经足以说明他们有多渴望鲜血。如今，轮到%companyname%的弟兄们来满足这群疯子了…… | 清场的人在竞技场里忙来忙去，拖走尸体，收起值得留下的东西，偶尔还往看台抛一件战利品。于是观众席也闹成一团，仿佛将场中的厮杀又演了一遍。如今，%companyname%也成了这场盛事的一部分。 | 竞技场虚位以待，观众热血沸腾，%companyname%赢取荣耀的时刻到了！ | %companyname%的弟兄们迈入血迹斑斑的斗场，观众爆发出轰鸣般的欢呼。这些人固然只是盲目地渴求鲜血，可想到即将献上表演的是自己的战团，你胸中仍不禁涌起一丝骄傲。 | 闸门升起，耳边只有铁链的响动、滑轮的吱嘎，以及奴隶干活时的闷哼。%companyname%的弟兄们从竞技场腹地走出来，能清楚听见脚下沙土的摩擦声，直到站定在场地中央。看台高处，一个陌生的声音高声叫喊，说的是你不懂的古老语言。话音只回荡一遍，便被观众的欢呼怒吼淹没。现在，弟兄们该在平民的注视下证明自己了。 | 平日里，%companyname%干活时，很少有旁人围观——人们总希望离那种暴力越远越好。可到了竞技场，平民却贪婪地等候死亡与痛苦。弟兄们入场时，他们嗜血地低吼；佣兵拔出武器准备作战时，他们又纵声咆哮。 | 竞技场像一处溃烂的疮口，被诸神撕去顶盖，将人的虚荣、嗜血与野蛮尽数暴露。里面的确都是人，吼着，叫着；若鲜血溅到身上，他们便抹得满脸都是，再互相咧嘴笑，仿佛这是什么笑话。他们为战利品打成一团，以别人的痛苦取乐。%companyname%就要在这群人面前作战，供他们消遣，而且得让他们看个尽兴。 | 竞技场的观众混杂着各个阶层，贫富挤作一团，只有维齐尔高坐于众人之上，单独占着席位。%townname%的居民暂时放下分歧，欢聚一堂，只为观看人和怪物互相残杀。%companyname%很乐意为此出一份力。 | 男孩骑在父亲肩上，少女向角斗士抛花，女人给自己扇风，男人则暗想自己上去能否有同样的本事。这便是竞技场的观众——剩下的人都已醉得不省人事，只会嚷些胡话。你希望%companyname%至少能让这群疯子快活上一两个小时。 | %companyname%的弟兄们一踏进斗场，观众便纵声欢呼。若把兴奋当作喜爱，那可真是傻：掌声刚落，空酒杯和烂番茄便零零散散地飞来，看热闹的人乐得咯咯直笑。你不禁怀疑，让%companyname%的弟兄们待在这里，是否有些浪费。不过，想想能赢到的金子与荣耀，再想想一天结束后，看台上的杂种们会回去过他们那狗屎般的日子，你也会回去过自己那狗屎般的日子，只是口袋至少能鼓上一点，便又觉得值得了。}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer% is swinging a thin crown around his finger. It is a cheap looking piece of metal, but no doubt a crown from somewhere. He looks you up and down as the tin scrapes and skitters over his fingernail and back again.%SPEECH_ON%I suspect I should have seen this coming. Men seek power, and those cut from the barbarian cloth are no different.%SPEECH_OFF%He lets the crown slide down to his knuckles where it hangs limply.%SPEECH_ON%The barbarians to the %direction% in the region of %region% are uniting under a so-called king. A savage so strong and nasty he threatens to get a horde and after that, well, I suspect he'll want to expand his realm south. I need you to go to this region, find this man, and cut him down.%SPEECH_OFF% | One of %employer%'s servants fetches you to a garden where you find the man tending to a tomato plant. He's pruning it with goat shears and nodding to his own handiwork. He talks loosely.%SPEECH_ON%My scouts tell me that a northern savage in %region% is gathering an army. A gathering of idiots is not too out of the ordinary for those primitives, but I do believe this one is proclaiming himself king. And kings, well, they wish to be suzerain over more than just what they got. They want what everyone else has got. What I got.%SPEECH_OFF%The man pauses and nods to you.%SPEECH_ON%I need you to go to the region of %region%, find this so-called savage king, and kill him. It will not be easy, but you will be paid quite well.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is surrounded by his lieutenants. They regard you with sneers, but %employer% ignores their judgments and makes his own.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, sellsword, I do believe a man of your chops is just the one I'm looking for. A barbarian in %region% has ordained himself king. He even wears a crown of some sort, probably of bone and antler, but it is the shape and purpose that matters. Not only matters to him, but to us. We can't allow him to live. I need you to go find this primitive and end him before he gathers an army too big for my fellow lieutenants here to deal with.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you with a mug of ale. He himself enjoys a goblet of wine.%SPEECH_ON%I've brought you here because there is a certain primitive in the region of %region% that I need killing. He is calling himself king, heh, suzerain over the savages. Well, while I don't respect his royal authority in the slightest, I know a budding threat when I see one. I can't wait around for this barbarian to round up the villages and gather an army. I need you to find him and kill him. It won't be easy, but you'll be paid well.%SPEECH_OFF%You now wonder if he's slipping you ale to loosen you into accepting this absurd task. | %employer% is holding a pair of deer antlers with the crown still at the base. When he puts it on his desk it stands upright as though still attached to its authorship.%SPEECH_ON%Word on the wind is that a savage in %region% is gathering an army. He is proclaiming himself king and if he can wrangle those primitives under his banner then that no doubt makes him a strong sonuvabitch. It also means we may be in a heap of shit here real soon if he isn't taken care of.%SPEECH_OFF%The man knocks the antlers over and they fall upon their tips with hollow clacks.%SPEECH_ON%So that's what you're here for, sellsword. I need you to find this barbarian and put an end to him before he gets any wise ideas about what he is and isn't suzerain over.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%'s sitting in his chair with pursed lips. He's thumbing a dagger around, the tip of it auguring a divot into his desk.%SPEECH_ON%My scouts to the %direction% started disappearing a little while ago. And then the survivors trickled in and with them tales of a barbarian proclaiming himself king of %region%. Now, do I need to conjure what the issue is with a savage ordaining himself ruler of a horde of primitives?%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him you can imagine it keeps him up at night. %employer% grins.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, that it does. So I need a man such as yourself, a strapping, nice, civilized sellsword. I need you to go and find this so-called king and kill him before he's got all those damn idiots marching under his banner.%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{%employer%正用手指转着一顶薄薄的王冠。那金属看着廉价，却无疑是从某处弄来的真王冠。锡片刮过指甲，又滑回去，他则上下打量着你。%SPEECH_ON%我想，这事本该早有预料。人都渴求权力，生来野蛮的家伙也不例外。%SPEECH_OFF%他任王冠滑到指节处，松松地挂在那里。%SPEECH_ON%%direction%的%region%一带，蛮族正聚集在一个所谓的国王麾下。那家伙既强壮又凶恶，眼看就要拉起一支大军。然后嘛，我想，他就该琢磨着向南扩张王国了。我要你去那片地区，找到这个人，杀了他。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的仆人将你领到花园。雇主正用剪羊毛的剪子修整一株番茄，还不时点头，欣赏自己的手艺。他漫不经心地开口。%SPEECH_ON%斥候告诉我，%region%有个北方野蛮人正在集结军队。那群未开化的家伙聚成一堆，本也不算稀奇。不过，这个似乎自称国王。国王嘛，想统治的可不止自己已有的东西。他们想要别人手里的东西。我手里的东西。%SPEECH_OFF%男人停下，朝你点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我要你去%region%，找到这个所谓的蛮王，杀了他。差事不轻松，不过，酬劳会很丰厚。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%身边围着几位副官。他们冷笑着打量你，%employer%却不理会那些目光，自有判断。%SPEECH_ON%啊，佣兵，我想，你这样有本事的人，正是我要找的。%region%有个野蛮人给自己加冕称王，甚至戴上了某种王冠，大概是骨头和鹿角做的。不过，重要的是它的形状，以及它所代表的意思。不只是对他重要，对我们也一样。不能让他活下去。我要你找到这个未开化的家伙，了结他，赶在他聚起一支连我身边这些副官都应付不了的大军之前。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%拿出一杯麦酒欢迎你，自己则品着高脚杯里的葡萄酒。%SPEECH_ON%请你来，是因为%region%有个野蛮人，我要他死。他自称国王，呵，野蛮人的君主。我虽然丝毫不把他的王权放在眼里，却也看得出什么叫初露苗头的威胁。我不能等着他召集村落，拉起军队。我要你找到他，杀了他。不会容易，不过，报酬丰厚。%SPEECH_OFF%你不禁怀疑，他特意拿麦酒招待，是不是想让你喝得松了口，接下这荒唐差事。 | %employer%手里拿着一对鹿角，根部还连着头骨顶。他将它放到桌上，鹿角便直立起来，仿佛仍长在原主身上。%SPEECH_ON%传言说，%region%有个野蛮人正在集结军队，还自称国王。若他真能把那些家伙拢到一面旗帜下，无疑是个厉害的狗娘养的。这也意味着，不尽早解决，我们很快就要陷入大麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%男人推倒鹿角，角尖撞上桌面，发出空洞的脆响。%SPEECH_ON%所以才叫你来，佣兵。我要你找到这个野蛮人，赶在他对自己该统治哪儿、不该统治哪儿生出高见之前，取他的命。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%抿着嘴坐在椅子里，手中转动匕首，用刀尖在桌面上钻出一个小坑。%SPEECH_ON%前些时候，我派往%direction%的斥候开始陆续失踪。后来，幸存者零零散散地回来了，也带回消息：一个野蛮人自称%region%的国王。现在，还需要我解释，让这种家伙当上一大群蛮子的统领，会有什么问题吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你说，想来这事足够让他夜里睡不着。%employer%咧嘴笑了。%SPEECH_ON%是啊，确实如此。所以，我需要你这样的人，一个结实、体面、讲文明的佣兵。我要你找到这个所谓的国王，趁那些该死的蠢货还没全聚到他旗下，把他杀了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]A throng of refugees passes the company by. Rumors abound that the barbarian king is %distance% to the %direction%. Many of the people on the road are from %nearest_town% and seem to have no interest in waiting around for a sea of savages to descend upon them. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]A trader with an empty merchant cart crosses paths with the company. Though he has nothing to peddle, he does state that the roads are flowing with rumors of a savage calling himself king. He states that the barbarian is somewhere %direction% of where you stand, around %region%. He regards the path of your journey with a nod.%SPEECH_ON%If you're keen on going that way, well, give them primitive bastards all the hell they deserve.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]A half-naked man is found sitting cross-legged to the side of the road. He states that a primitive with an army burned his farmstead, wronged the women, and slew every swinging dick.%SPEECH_ON%I survived hiding in a brush pile with my hands wrapped over my mouth.%SPEECH_OFF%The man wipes his nose.%SPEECH_ON%I seen you with your weapons. If you seek this barbarian then I can tell ya it seemed they was heading %direction% of here, down %terrain% %distance% aways to %region%.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]You find the burnt remains of a small hamlet. A few of its survivors linger, their shapes about as present as the smoke drifting off their destroyed homes. One states that a man posturing like a king came and killed everyone they got their hands on before heading %direction%. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]You've come across a number of flipped carts or burning wagons. They're barren, all the goods gone, only the corpses of their owners remain. A few children are picking through the rubble of one such ruin. When you ask them who did this, a cheeky boy speaks up.%SPEECH_ON%Savages from the north, but they headin' %direction% now. I seen them. They is %terrain%, %distance% I wager. %SPEECH_OFF%He picks his nose.%SPEECH_ON%They is killers, by the way. Kinda look your sort, but larger. Probably stronger.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]A scout of %employer% meets you on the road. He reports that the barbarian king was sighted around %region% to the %direction% %terrain%. He is %distance%. You ask the scout if he'd join you for the fight and the man laughs.%SPEECH_ON%No sir, I'm quite alright. I run about, see things, and report them. In between I fark a whore or two. It's a good life and I don't need your sellsword ways ruinin' it!%SPEECH_OFF%Fair enough. | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]%randombrother% spots them first. Signs of a skirmish, charred corpses, faded footprints and wagon tracks, so many that it is clear an army passed through here.%SPEECH_ON%Looks like they was headin' %direction% after the battle, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]一群难民与战团擦肩而过。传闻四起，说蛮族之王在%direction%那边。至于远近，传闻的说法是‘%distance%’。路上的许多人都来自%nearest_town%，显然不愿留在原地，等那片蛮族的人潮压过来。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_41.png[/img]一个推着空货车的商人与战团相遇。他虽已无货可卖，却告诉你，路上都在传，有个野蛮人自称国王。按他的说法，那家伙就在你们%direction%的某处，%region%一带。他朝你们要走的方向点点头。%SPEECH_ON%如果非要往那边去，就给那些蛮子狠狠吃些苦头。他们活该。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]一个半裸男人盘腿坐在路旁。他说，有个野蛮人带着军队烧了他的农庄，凌辱了女人，杀光了男人。%SPEECH_ON%我躲在一堆灌木里，双手捂住嘴，才捡回一条命。%SPEECH_OFF%男人擦了擦鼻子。%SPEECH_ON%我看见你们带着武器。若是来找那个野蛮人的，我倒能告诉你：他们似乎朝%direction%的%region%去了，就在%terrain%。离这儿多远？%distance%。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_94.png[/img]你发现一座小村落被烧毁的残骸。几个幸存者仍徘徊其间，身影与废墟上飘起的烟雾一样虚无。有人说，一个摆着国王架势的男人来了，逮到谁就杀谁，随后往%direction%去了。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]你一路遇见许多翻倒的小货车和燃烧的货车。车里空空如也，货物尽失，只剩主人的尸体。几个孩子正在其中一处残骸里翻找。你问是谁干的，一个胆大的男孩开口。%SPEECH_ON%北边来的蛮子，不过现在往%direction%去了。我看见他们了。他们在%terrain%。要问多远，我猜是‘%distance%’。%SPEECH_OFF%他抠了抠鼻子。%SPEECH_ON%对了，他们杀人。看着跟你们有点像，不过块头更大，八成也更强壮。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_76.png[/img]%employer%的一名斥候在路上找到你。他报告说，蛮族之王在%direction%的%region%一带的%terrain%活动。至于远近，他的说法是‘%distance%’。你问斥候要不要加入这场战斗，男人笑了。%SPEECH_ON%不了，大人，我现在就挺好。四处跑跑，看看动静，回来报信，空闲时再找一两个婊子。这日子够好了，可不想让你们佣兵的活法把它毁了！%SPEECH_OFF%倒也在理。 | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_132.png[/img]%randombrother%最先发现了痕迹：小规模交战的残迹、烧焦的尸体、渐淡的脚印，还有车辙。痕迹如此之多，显然有一支军队从这里经过。%SPEECH_ON%团长，看样子他们打完以后，往%direction%去了。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.reason: 对照七个随机分支及官方变量来源，修复北的某处等方向拼接；Distance 六种值均可作离这里后的谓语，将很近、有一段路等自然融入叙述，去掉像读界面标签般的距离引号。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{You find the Barbarian King, but a parlay is made. The Barbarian King and an elder step across the field to meet you personally. Against better judgment, you go out to see them. The Barbarian King speaks and the elder translates.%SPEECH_ON%We are not here to conquer, but to defeat the Great Untoward.%SPEECH_OFF%Suspecting a loss of translation, you ask them to explain. The King and elder continue.%SPEECH_ON%Death has left this land, and in its absence a man slain becomes lost between worlds and will rise again. A horde of Untoward, the Undead, are on the march. We are not here for you or your nobles. If you help us destroy them we will depart the land and trouble your people no more. Only the Untoward.%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother% leans in and whispers.%SPEECH_ON%We could join them, sure, but we could also just go ahead and attack them now. They're clearly not at full strength and whatever they say here the fact is they've been ravaging the lands anyway, because they're primitive savages, sir, and raping and pillaging is just what they got in their blood.%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_136.png[/img]{你找到了蛮族之王，对方却提出会谈。他和一位长者穿过空地，亲自前来见你。明知不够稳妥，你还是走出去与他们碰面。蛮族之王开口，长者代为翻译。%SPEECH_ON%我们来此，不为征服，而为击败大凶之物。%SPEECH_OFF%你怀疑翻译没把意思说清，便请他们解释。王与长者接着说下去。%SPEECH_ON%死亡离开了这片土地。没有死亡，被杀之人便迷失在世界之间，随后重新站起。一大群凶物，也就是亡灵，正在行军。我们不是冲你们或你们的贵族来的。帮我们消灭它们，我们就离开这片土地，不再侵扰你们的人民。我们只追杀凶物。%SPEECH_OFF%%randombrother%凑近，低声说道：%SPEECH_ON%咱们当然可以跟他们联手，不过，现在直接动手也行。看得出来，他们人马还没齐。再说，不管他们怎么解释，四处烧杀抢掠总是事实。团长，他们就是些未开化的野蛮人，强暴和劫掠，是流在血里的本性。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{You enter %employer%'s room. The man is picking his fingers with a peacock feather, wagging its colors around on one end while fishing out grime with the other. He talks rather dismissively to your presence.%SPEECH_ON%My guards have already informed that you are interested in a beast hunt and I'm quite glad that you are. The pay will be per head. Smaller beasts, webknechts, corpse eating things, the sort I'm sure are of no trouble to you, but which the fellow locals are too scared to confront. If you're as good at your job as folks seem to say, then you shouldn't dally jumping on this offer. Rid my lands of these. To start with, there's been sightings in the region of %worldmapregion% %distance% %direction% of here.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you into his room. He takes a scroll the town crier had given you while walking through the markets earlier.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, you're here for the beast hunt then. I thought you were entertainment of a...%SPEECH_OFF%He pinches the side of your shirt and tilts a smile.%SPEECH_ON%Different sort. Well, nonetheless, beasts are ravaging the countryside and I'd happily pay you a tidy sum to take care of them. The pay will be per head, of course, giving you a wealth of riches to earn if you keep that blade of yours slick. If you need a place to start your hunt, travel to the region of %worldmapregion% %distance% %direction% of here. There you'll find an assortment of large eight-legged freaks and furry monsters. Whatever it is that would frighten a common farmer, nothing too scary for you though, you big man you.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% with his bootless feet up on a table, a throng of women pruning them. They thumb plugs of thickened dirt from between his toes like the birth rites of some imago monstrosity. You clear your throat. The man clears his throat in a startled return.%SPEECH_ON%Ah yes, the sellsword. Here, I've a task for you if you are interested.%SPEECH_OFF%He dismissively throws a scroll at your feet which lists a need for beast slaying. Webknechts. Slender wolves. Nothing too frightening. A note on the map points to the nearby region of %worldmapregion% to the %direction%. The man belches.%SPEECH_ON%The pay is per head, hope that suits you well.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% turning a helve in hand. The demarcation between handle and where the blade should have been is clearly splintered, showing a decisive end to the weapon's use. The man throws it on his table and claps sawdust off his palms.%SPEECH_ON%Beasts are roaming these parts and I need someone of your stock to slay them all. What say you, hm? The pay will be by the head. To start your hunt, head to the region of %worldmapregion% to the %direction%. All manner of lesser beasts are being a nuisance there.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% welcomes you to his room. His table is covered in scrolls, each with drawings of animals and beasts and possibly even monsters. He's jawing on some berries, spitting juice as he talks.%SPEECH_ON%Locals say there are foul things afoot, though not a one will give me a proper description as to what it is the trouble. Something about monstrous wolves or eight-legged monsters. I can hardly stand around and do nothing so that's why I'm requesting your services. Head to the fief of %worldmapregion% %distance% %direction%. If you see any beasts then slay them where they stand and take their heads. I'll pay by the scalp.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% meets you while in congress with a group of farmers. He states that supposed monsters are tearing the hinterland to pieces. A farmer pipes up.%SPEECH_ON%Beasts, the lot of them. Wolves that walk on their hindlegs, spiders yea big, corpse eating things that stink of scum.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman waves his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Yes, yes, that's enough. Sellsword, I need you to go to head out and hunt these creatures down. Start by travelling to the region of %worldmapregion% to the %direction% of here and see to it that any beasts afoot are put to the earth. But do be sure to bring back their heads, I'll be paying you for each. That is, if you're interested of course.%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{你走进%employer%的房间。男人拿着一根孔雀羽毛剔指甲，一端的彩羽晃来晃去，另一端则挑着污垢。他说话时，对你颇不在意。%SPEECH_ON%卫兵已经告诉我，你对狩猎野兽有兴趣，我很高兴。报酬按头算。都是些小点的野兽，巨蛛、吃尸体的东西之类，想必难不倒你，本地人却吓得不敢面对。你若真像传闻那样有本事，就该立刻接下这份差事。替我的领地清掉它们。先从%worldmapregion%一带找起，在%direction%方向，距此%distance%，那里有人见过。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%欢迎你进屋，接过你先前逛市场时，从传令员手里拿到的卷轴。%SPEECH_ON%啊，原来是为狩猎来的。我还以为，你是来提供某种……%SPEECH_OFF%他捏起你的衣角，歪嘴一笑。%SPEECH_ON%别样的消遣。不过，无妨。野兽正在乡间肆虐，我很乐意出一笔好价钱，请你收拾它们。当然，按头计酬。只要你的刀够勤快，就有大把财富可赚。不知道从哪儿开始的话，就去%worldmapregion%一带，%direction%边，距此%distance%。那里有各种硕大的八条腿怪物，还有毛茸茸的恶兽。总之，是能吓坏普通农夫的东西。可你这么个大男人，当然不会怕。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%脱了靴子，将双脚搁在桌上，一群女人正替他清理。她们用拇指从趾缝间挤出一坨坨厚重污垢，仿佛在给什么怪虫接生。你清了清嗓子。男人一惊，也跟着清嗓。%SPEECH_ON%啊，对，佣兵。这里有桩差事，看你有没有兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF%他随手将卷轴扔到你脚边，上面列着需要剿杀的野兽：巨蛛，瘦长的狼，没什么太可怕的。地图上的标记指向附近%direction%边的%worldmapregion%。男人打了个嗝。%SPEECH_ON%按头付钱，希望你满意。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正转着一根兵器柄。柄身与原本刃部相接的地方已经断裂，木刺参差，足见这件兵器再也用不了了。他将它扔到桌上，拍去掌心木屑。%SPEECH_ON%这一带有野兽横行，我需要你这种人把它们全杀了。怎么样？按头付钱。先往%direction%边的%worldmapregion%一带找，那里各种小兽都在惹麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%欢迎你进屋。桌上铺满卷轴，画着各种动物、野兽，也许还有怪物。他正嚼着浆果，一开口就喷果汁。%SPEECH_ON%本地人都说有恶兽出没，可没一个能像样地说明白，到底是什么麻烦。好像是怪狼，或是什么八条腿的怪物。我总不能干站着什么也不做，所以才请你来。去%worldmapregion%那片领地，%direction%边，距此%distance%。看见野兽，就当场杀掉，取下脑袋。我按头皮付钱。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%与一群农民议事时，接见了你。他说，有些所谓的怪物正将郊野搅得天翻地覆。一个农民插嘴道：%SPEECH_ON%全是恶兽。拿后腿走路的狼，这么大的蜘蛛，还有臭烘烘、吃尸体的东西。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族挥挥手。%SPEECH_ON%是，是，够了。佣兵，我要你出发，猎杀这些东西。先去这里%direction%边的%worldmapregion%一带，把游荡的野兽都放倒。不过，务必带回脑袋，每颗我都付钱。当然，得看你有没有兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{%employer% is flipping the pages of a tome when you enter. He looks up and waves you over.%SPEECH_ON%Bring a candle.%SPEECH_OFF%You take a sconce off the wall and the nobleman throws his hands up.%SPEECH_ON%I said a candle not a bloody torch! What do you aim to do, burn every book I have to ash? Just stay right where you are. Look, folks around these parts have been speaking of evils I've not heard of in years. Monsters that prey upon your dreams, giants so large a man could fit inside their beards, and the worst of them, of course, beautiful women who know they're beautiful.%SPEECH_OFF%You're not so sure about that last one, but don't speak to it. The nobleman goes on to explain that you are to slay every one of these cretins you find throughout his realm. There's been sightings at %worldmapregion% to the %direction%, but you're free to hunt the creatures at your discretion wherever they may hide. | You find %employer% in congress with a number of men in black cloaks. They bid you to come over which you reluctantly do. The nobleman asks if you know of monsters like unholds, or creatures that feast on dreams. Before you can answer, he waves his hand.%SPEECH_ON%No matter. I need some armed men to comb through the %worldmapregion% region %direction% of here and see if anything strange is afoot. If it ain't human with a heartbeat, kill it. Take its head. And come back to me. I'll pay you handsomely for each scalp. If they exist, that is.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is weighing scrolls in both hands, reading neither as he stares at a third on his desk. Finally, he tosses the two and swipes away the last. He looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%Word is spreading about monsters being afoot. Giant men eating cattle and children. I've reports of people having nightmares and killing their neighbors over them. And then there is a lot of word going around about a beautiful woman in these parts. I don't know if she's a foul creature of any sort, but a beautiful woman inhabiting %worldmapregion% to the %direction% of here sounds an awful lot like trouble to me.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod. A woman alone in a strange area, that's certainly trouble for someone. The nobleman throws his arms wide.%SPEECH_ON%Would you take your men to this land and find the line between truth and fiction? And if you find something that slithers or hisses or is otherwise unhuman, slay the damned thing and bring me its head.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% poring over some books with a candle so close to the page the penumbra pales at the tome's edges. It is as if he alone should read the texts. Seeing you, he waves you forward.%SPEECH_ON%I've reports of strange happenings in the region of %worldmapregion% to the %direction%. Murders are up and all the hells if I know why. And then some folks are just flat disappearing. Never a good sign. I don't know if it's cult or creature which is responsible, but I need some armed men to go to this land and set it straight. If you cross steel with something unworldly, then bring me its head for such a thing I shall pay handsomely for.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found atop a ladder, rifling through the highest shelf he has. He shakes his head and waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%I don't have a goddam clue of what it is I'm looking for.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell him to join the club. The man climbs down.%SPEECH_ON%Very funny, mercenary. Look, I'm getting word of chaos in the region of %worldmapregion% %distance% %direction% of here. Not many folks live out that way, but those who do are speaking of absolute horrors walking the land. Giant men, spirits infesting their dreams, you name it. I need you to take your band of men and quell that which 'bubbles and boils', yeah? And bring me the heads of any inhuman monstrosity you find. I'll pay you well for each.%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_63.png[/img]{你进来时，%employer%正翻着一本大书。他抬头，招手让你过去。%SPEECH_ON%拿支蜡烛来。%SPEECH_OFF%你从墙上取下火把，贵族顿时举起双手。%SPEECH_ON%我说蜡烛，不是该死的火把！你想把我的藏书全烧成灰吗？就站那儿别动。听着，附近的人又开始说起那些多年没听过的邪物：吞食梦境的怪物，大得能把整个人藏进胡须的巨人，还有最可怕的，当然，是那些既美貌、又知道自己美貌的女人。%SPEECH_OFF%最后一条，你不太认同，不过没说出口。贵族接着交代，凡在他的领地内遇见这些恶物，都要杀掉。有人在%direction%边的%worldmapregion%见过它们，不过，无论它们藏在哪里，你都可以自行追猎。 | %employer%正与几个黑斗篷男人议事。他们叫你过去，你不太情愿地走上前。贵族问，你是否听过巨魔，或是以梦为食的怪物。还没等你回答，他便一摆手。%SPEECH_ON%无所谓。我需要一些带武器的人，搜遍这里%direction%边的%worldmapregion%，看看有没有怪东西作祟。只要不是有心跳的活人，就杀掉，割下脑袋，带回来给我。每颗头，我都付厚酬。当然，前提是它们真存在。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%两手各托一卷卷轴，却一卷也没读，只盯着桌上第三卷。最后，他扔下手里的，又扫开桌上的，抬眼看你。%SPEECH_ON%怪物出没的消息四处传开。有巨人吃牛，也吃孩子；还有人做了噩梦，醒来就杀邻居。另外，最近总听说，这一带来了个美貌女人。我不知道她算不算邪物，可漂亮女人住在这里%direction%边的%worldmapregion%，听着就像麻烦。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头。一个女人独自在陌生地方生活，确实总会给某个人惹上麻烦。贵族张开双臂。%SPEECH_ON%愿不愿意带上你的人，去那里分清哪些是真，哪些是假？若碰见爬来爬去、嘶嘶作响，或是别的不像人的东西，就杀了那该死的玩意，把脑袋带回来。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正埋头读书。蜡烛几乎贴到书页，光照到书边便渐渐没入阴影，仿佛这些文字只能供他一人阅读。看见你，他招手让你近前。%SPEECH_ON%有人报告，%direction%边的%worldmapregion%一带出了怪事。凶杀越来越多，见鬼，我哪知道为什么。还有些人干脆消失了，从来不是好兆头。我不知道是邪教还是怪物作祟，但需要一些持械的人去把事情平息。若与什么不属于人间的东西交过手，就带它的脑袋回来。这样的东西，我愿付重金。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%站在梯子顶端，翻找最高一层书架。他摇摇头，挥手让你进来。%SPEECH_ON%我他妈根本不知道自己在找什么。%SPEECH_OFF%你点头，说你也一样，正好作伴。男人爬下梯子。%SPEECH_ON%真风趣，佣兵。听着，据说%worldmapregion%那一带乱了套，在%direction%方向，距此%distance%。那边住的人不多，可住在那儿的，都说大地上游荡着骇人的东西：巨人、侵入梦境的幽灵，什么都有。我要你带着手下，去平息那股‘翻涌沸腾的祸患’，明白吗？凡遇到非人的怪物，都把脑袋带回来。每一颗，我都付厚酬。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]You take a bow and nock an arrow. A few of the brothers watch as you take aim. The wind comes, goes, and comes again. You wait patiently before drawing the string and closing one eye to put the dog into focus. It sits down and stares at you between long-tongued pants.

You release the shot. The arrow zips through the air and the dog yelps. It keels back on its hind legs and falls over, its feet kicking and scraping on the ground until it stops. You put the bow back into its holding and get the company back on the road.
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你取来弓，搭上一支箭。几个弟兄在旁边看着你瞄准。风起了，停了，又起了。你耐心等候，随后拉开弓弦，闭上一只眼，将狗锁在准星里。它坐下来，吐着长舌喘气，直直地望着你。

你松开弓弦。箭矢破空而去，狗发出一声惨叫。它后腿一仰，翻倒在地，四肢蹬踢刨抓，终于不再动弹。你把弓放回原处，带着战团继续赶路。
changes.after:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_27.png[/img]你取来弓，搭上一支箭。几个弟兄在旁边看着你瞄准。风起了，停了，又起了。你耐心等候，随后拉开弓弦，闭上一只眼，瞄准了那条狗。它坐下来，吐着长舌喘气，直直地望着你。

你松开弓弦。箭矢破空而去，狗发出一声惨叫。它后腿一仰，翻倒在地，四肢蹬踢刨抓，终于不再动弹。你把弓放回原处，带着战团继续赶路。
changes.reason: 弓箭瞄准场景不应凭空加入准星。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_37.png[/img]A rugged dog such as he would make for a great mascot. The little mutt could definitely boost morale. You order %bro% to feed it some food in the hopes that it'll tag along. He goes out with a scrap of leftovers and crouches down.%SPEECH_ON%Good dog.%SPEECH_OFF%The mongrel sniffs the food, then chomps down on it - and the mercenary's hand along with it. The brother jumps back, nestling his arm into his chest as though he might lose it otherwise. The dog, on the other hand, swallows the scrap and then runs off.
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_37.png[/img]这么一条皮实的狗，正适合当战团的吉祥物。小家伙肯定能让弟兄们高兴些。你叫%bro%拿点吃的喂它，希望它肯留下。他拿着一块剩饭剩肉走过去，蹲下身。%SPEECH_ON%好狗，乖。%SPEECH_OFF%杂毛狗嗅了嗅食物，接着一口咬下——连佣兵的手也一并咬住了。弟兄猛地跳开，把胳膊紧紧抱在胸前，仿佛稍一松手就会掉下来。狗则吞下食物，一溜烟跑了。
changes.after: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_37.png[/img]这么一条皮实的狗，正适合当战团的吉祥物。小家伙肯定能让弟兄们高兴些。你叫%bro%拿点吃的喂它，希望它肯留下。他拿着一小块剩下的吃食走过去，蹲下身。%SPEECH_ON%好狗，乖。%SPEECH_OFF%杂毛狗嗅了嗅食物，接着一口咬下——连佣兵的手也一并咬住了。弟兄猛地跳开，把胳膊紧紧抱在胸前，仿佛稍一松手就会掉下来。狗则吞下食物，一溜烟跑了。
changes.reason: 修正食物量词搭配，使动作描写符合中文。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]He leans back, rubbing one of his knees with a calloused hand. A bit of wind throws his tufts of greyed hair around.%SPEECH_ON%Old. That's how I'm doing. And I don't mean my age. By the years, I've been old for a while now. I mean I'm old in the bones. I suppose I get by on reputation a lot more than skills these days.%SPEECH_OFF%You immediately disagree, telling him that he's one of the deadliest men you've ever met.%SPEECH_ON%Save the niceties for the women, captain. My vision's going. You probably don't want to hear that, but it is. My lead foot doesn't step like it used to. The knee clicks, seizes up. One day that is going to cost me. My off-hand has no feeling.%SPEECH_OFF%The swordmaster clenches and unclenches his free-hand.
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_17.png[/img]他向后靠去，用长满老茧的手揉着膝盖。一阵风吹乱了他几绺灰白的头发。%SPEECH_ON%老了。就这么回事。不是说年纪——论年纪，我早就老了。我说的是骨头里透出来的老。如今我多半是靠名气吃饭，本事倒用得少了。%SPEECH_OFF%你立刻反驳，说他仍是你见过最可怕的杀手之一。%SPEECH_ON%好听话留着哄女人吧，团长。我的眼睛不行了。你大概不爱听，可事实就是如此。前脚迈出去，也不如从前利索。膝盖咔咔响，时不时就僵住，迟早要吃大亏。另一只手，已经没知觉了。%SPEECH_OFF%剑术大师将空着的那只手握紧，又松开。

changes.reason: 原文指如今更多靠名声维持生计，并非只是较少运用本领。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]You put a hand to the pommel of your sword and decline the assassin's request. He claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, sellsword. Fair enough. And don't bother with the theatrics there.%SPEECH_OFF%He nods to your sword-hand.%SPEECH_ON%If I really wanted the bastard dead, do you think I'd be standing here? I came to talk, and talk we did. The killing life has left me and with it, apparently, so too did my poker face. You called my bluff and I suppose that's that. Good evening, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can say another word, the assassin ducks out of the tent. You rush to see where he'd gone to, but all you find is the dark of night. %bastard% the bastard spies you peering around and asks what you're up to. You smile and tell him to get some rest for he truly deserves it. Confused, the man shrugs.%SPEECH_ON%Well, uh, I guess so. Thanks, captain.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_33.png[/img]你把手按在剑柄上，拒绝了刺客的要求。他拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，佣兵。也罢。你也不用再摆那架势了。%SPEECH_OFF%他朝你按剑的手点点头。%SPEECH_ON%我要真想杀那私生子，你觉得我还会站在这里？我是来谈的，也已经谈过了。我不想再当杀手，看来连装模作样的本事都跟着没了。你看穿了我在虚张声势，事情也就到此为止。晚上好，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你还没来得及再说一句，刺客便钻出了帐篷。你赶出去看他去了哪里，眼前却只有黑夜。私生子%bastard%见你四处张望，问你在做什么。你笑笑，叫他去好好休息，说这是他应得的。那人一头雾水，耸了耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，呃，大概是吧。谢了，团长。%SPEECH_OFF%

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]%brawler% and %noncom% are found in a mudpit with their hands wrapped in cloth and leaves, padding for the knuckles and to keep them from cutting one another with every punch. The brawler has his trainee bouncing counter-clockwise along the ring of the fighting circle, punching the air as he goes, and with his trainer hitting or kicking him every time he passes by. The men glisten with sweat as they work. When %noncom% begins to slow, %brawler% hits him as though a jockey would a sluggish horse.

 After an hour of this, %brawler% steps back and invites his trainee to attack him. Predictably, the assault is aimless and pitiful. Long, looping punches are thrown with no energy behind them. The brawler ducks and weaves out of the way, punching every attempted strike with a counter-punch of his own.%SPEECH_ON%See what happens when you are tired? This is why we must train. Even the most able and deadly are worth nothing without air in their lungs and fresh legs beneath them.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你看见%brawler%与%noncom%站在泥地里，双手缠着布条和树叶，给指节垫上一层，免得拳拳都把对方打得皮开肉绽。拳斗者让徒弟沿着圈子逆时针蹦跳，一边移动一边对空挥拳。每次从师父面前经过，还得挨上一拳或一脚。两人练得汗光淋漓。只要%noncom%稍一慢下来，%brawler%就像骑手抽打懒马一样，打他一下。

练了一个时辰，%brawler%退后，示意徒弟攻过来。不出所料，进攻既杂乱，又可怜。拳头抡得老远，却半点劲道也没有。拳斗者左闪右避，每躲过一次攻击，便还上一记反击。%SPEECH_ON%看见累了会怎么样了吧？所以才要练。再能打、再狠的人，肺里喘不上气，脚下没了力气，也一样是废物。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.after:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_06.png[/img]你看见%brawler%与%noncom%站在泥地里，双手缠着布条和树叶，给指节垫上一层，免得拳拳都把对方打得皮开肉绽。拳斗者让徒弟沿着圈子逆时针蹦跳，一边移动一边对空挥拳。每次从师父面前经过，还得挨上一拳或一脚。两人练得汗光淋漓。只要%noncom%稍一慢下来，%brawler%就像骑手抽打懒马一样，打他一下。

练了一个小时，%brawler%退后，示意徒弟攻过来。不出所料，进攻既杂乱，又可怜。拳头抡得老远，却半点劲道也没有。拳斗者左闪右避，每躲过一次攻击，便还上一记反击。%SPEECH_ON%看见累了会怎么样了吧？所以才要练。再能打、再狠的人，肺里喘不上气，脚下没了力气，也一样是废物。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.reason: an hour 为一小时；时辰通常指两小时，导致时长翻倍。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]%monk% the monk steps forward and brings the children to a huddle. They instantly respect the man, for he represents in part the very cause they wish to promote. He bends a knee.%SPEECH_ON%Was it the old gods who told you to come out and do this?%SPEECH_OFF%The little leader nods.%SPEECH_ON%They spoke to me in my sleep.%SPEECH_OFF%The monk nods back, rubbing his chin and mulling it over. He pats the boy on his head.%SPEECH_ON%The old gods speak to me and I for them. Interpreting their message requires years of study, let me tell ya! Are you certain that it was you, little one, that was meant to carry this burden? Perhaps you were to be the messenger, no? See us, we're warriors. Fit, fighting men who can kill those who despise and demark the old gods. You are not yet like us, but you have a strong voice and the command of a true leader yet. I believe the old gods wanted to use you for your charisma, not your muscles.%SPEECH_OFF%The monk gives the boy a playful push. He smiles, realizing the truth of what the friar has to say. The little leader tells his party that they are to return home as the monk is assuredly right. Some men are thankful that these kids were talked out of going to a certain doom.
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_97.png[/img]修士%monk%走上前，把孩子们聚拢过来。孩子们立刻对他肃然起敬，毕竟他多少代表着他们想宣扬的信仰。他屈下一膝，蹲到孩子们面前。%SPEECH_ON%是旧神叫你们出来做这件事的吗？%SPEECH_OFF%小头领点点头。%SPEECH_ON%他们在梦里跟我说的。%SPEECH_OFF%修士也点点头，捋着下巴思索片刻，随后摸摸男孩的头。%SPEECH_ON%旧神也对我说话，我也替他们传言。要读懂神意，可得钻研好多年呢！孩子，你确定，他们是要你亲自挑起这副担子吗？或许，你该做的是传递消息，对不对？你看我们，都是战士，身强体健，会打仗，能杀死那些轻蔑、诋毁旧神的人。你还没长成我们这样，可你的声音有力量，也已经懂得像个真正的领袖那样带领别人。我相信，旧神想借重的是你的号召力，而不是你的胳膊。%SPEECH_OFF%修士打趣地轻推男孩一下。男孩笑了，明白这番话在理。他告诉同伴，修士说得对，大家该回家了。有些弟兄很感激修士，毕竟这些孩子总算被劝离了那条必死之路。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]You kick your feet out, legs akimbo, and place your hands in your lap. Nodding, you speak to the man.%SPEECH_ON%Alright, %cocky%. You're the man now. You gotta count inventory every morning and night. I know you can't count for shite, but you'll learn. Don't want these fine men going into battle a few arrows short.%SPEECH_OFF%You throw a hand out to a few of the tents.%SPEECH_ON%You'll also need to keep a steady count on your people. They're not easily controlled, to which you might find some irony - or not.%SPEECH_OFF%Looking at your hands, which have grown calloused and bruised over the days, you keep talking.%SPEECH_ON%And you'll need to bark orders that aren't just there to be heard - but there to keep men alive and breathing. You know, like yourself and those who sit around you. So yeah, take the job, %cocky%. It's yours.%SPEECH_OFF%As soon as you finish, a group of brothers immediately stands up and begs for you to remain in charge. %cocky%, seeing this, backs down and slinks away as yells of 'you're in charge!' fill the air.
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_26.png[/img]你舒展双腿，把手放在膝上，点着头对那人说道。%SPEECH_ON%好啊，%cocky%。现在你当家。每天早晚，你都得清点物资。我知道你数数一塌糊涂，不过可以学。总不能让这些好弟兄上战场时，才发现少了几支箭。%SPEECH_OFF%你抬手指了指几顶帐篷。%SPEECH_ON%你还得随时管好手下。他们可不好管，这话听起来是不是有点讽刺——也许你听不出来。%SPEECH_OFF%你低头看看那双日渐长满老茧、遍布瘀伤的手，继续说。%SPEECH_ON%还有，下命令不能光图喊得响，得让弟兄们活下来，喘着气回来。比如你，还有围在你身边这些人。所以，接任吧，%cocky%。这差事归你了。%SPEECH_OFF%你刚说完，一群弟兄便立刻站起来，恳请你继续领队。%cocky%见状，泄了气，悄悄溜走。四下满是“还是你来当家”的呼声。

changes.reason: keep a steady count 指维持人数清点，原译泛化为管人，遗漏团长的具体职责。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]While on the road, you come across a crowd of people huddled around a mound of earth. Getting closer, you realize that it's a funeral. One of the attendees turns to look at you.%SPEECH_ON%Did you know him? Did you fight by his side?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head and start cutting into the crowd to see the man himself. You find a man looking about as old as the dead can look. He's got a terrifically sharp and glinting sword running along his chest with his grubby, wormfood fingers clutching the pommel. %randombrother% joins your side and whispers.%SPEECH_ON%That's, uh, a pretty nice lookin' weapon there, just saying.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]赶路时，你遇到一群围着土堆站立的人。走近才发现，这是一场葬礼。一名送葬者转头问你。%SPEECH_ON%你认识他？曾和他并肩打过仗？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇摇头，挤进人群，想看看死者。他老得几乎到了死人能有的极限。一柄锋利耀眼的长剑横放在胸前，那双肮脏、很快就要喂蛆的手，仍握着剑柄。%randombrother%凑到你身边，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%那把兵器，呃，看着真不错。我就是随口一说。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.after: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_28.png[/img]赶路时，你遇到一群围着土堆站立的人。走近才发现，这是一场葬礼。一名送葬者转头问你。%SPEECH_ON%你认识他？曾和他并肩打过仗？%SPEECH_OFF%你摇摇头，挤进人群，想看看死者。死者看上去年纪大得不能再大了。一柄锋利耀眼的长剑横放在胸前，那双肮脏、很快就要喂蛆的手，仍握着剑柄。%randombrother%凑到你身边，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%那把兵器，呃，看着真不错。我就是随口一说。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.reason: 去除套用英文比较结构的机械表达，保留死者极其年迈之意。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]You give the order to attack. Your men arm themselves and rush forward. The fire dies in an instant, swirling down to nothing but ash which plumes out in a great cloud. Once it is gone, the eerie crowd opens their arms and speak in unison.%SPEECH_ON%Davkul awaits. Come and greet him.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]你下令进攻。弟兄们拿起兵器，冲了出去。篝火瞬间熄灭，旋转着塌缩成灰，随后扬起一大团尘云。待灰烬散去，那群阴森的人张开双臂，齐声说道。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔正在等候。来迎接他吧。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.after: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_140.png[/img]你下令进攻。弟兄们拿起兵器，冲了出去。篝火瞬间熄灭，旋转着塌缩成灰，随后扬起一大团尘云。待灰烬散去，那群阴森的人张开双臂，齐声说道。%SPEECH_ON%达夫库尔正在等候。来见他吧。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.reason: Davkul awaits 表示达夫库尔在等众人前去，greet 此处不指迎接他的到来。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{This isn't your war, but you've little doubt that gaining good favor with the nobles will help you down the road. You order your men to start separating the crowd, plucking the strongest from the weak. But the peasants don't cooperate - a stone goes spiraling past your face. %randombrother% charges into the crowd and stabs the assailant through the chest. A few laymen retaliate, bringing out pitchforks and torches. The rest of the %companyname% draws weapons and, after a few quick slayings, the crowd settles. You look around for the lieutenant, but he and his men are nowhere to be seen. | Drawing out your sword, you order the village to start lining up, strongest to weakest. Instead, an old man rallies them with poorly timed anti-war sentiments. %randombrother% walks over to the fool and uncorks a punch to silence him right into the mud. Sadly, this only pisses the crowd off more and a great melee breaks out. Your mercenaries are merciless, cutting down anyone who dares stand against the company. After it's all said and done there are dead and dying in the mud, all tended to by women with confused and saddened faces, and the lieutenant and his soldiers are nowhere to be seen.}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{这不是你的战争，但讨得贵族欢心，今后无疑大有好处。你命令弟兄们分开人群，从羸弱者中挑出最强壮的人。然而农民并不配合——一块石头擦着你的脸飞过。%randombrother%冲进人群，一剑刺穿扔石者的胸膛。几个平民拿出草叉和火把还击，%companyname%的其他人便也拔出武器。接连杀掉几个人后，人群终于安静下来。你四下寻找副官，他和士兵们却早已不见踪影。 | 你拔出剑，命令村民按强壮到瘦弱的顺序列队。一个老人却在这时候鼓动众人反对战争。%randombrother%走向那蠢货，一拳把他打进泥里，让他闭了嘴。可惜，这只让人群更加愤怒，一场混战就此爆发。手下毫不留情，把所有胆敢与战团作对的人尽数砍倒。事后，泥里躺满了死人和垂死之人，女人们满脸茫然与悲痛，照料着伤者；副官和他的士兵却不知去了哪里。}
changes.after: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_60.png[/img]{这不是你的战争，但讨得贵族欢心，今后无疑大有好处。你命令弟兄们分开人群，把最强壮的人从人群中挑出来。然而农民并不配合——一块石头擦着你的脸飞过。%randombrother%冲进人群，一剑刺穿扔石者的胸膛。几个平民拿出草叉和火把还击，%companyname%的其他人便也拔出武器。接连杀掉几个人后，人群终于安静下来。你四下寻找副官，他和士兵们却早已不见踪影。 | 你拔出剑，命令村民按强壮到瘦弱的顺序列队。一个老人却在这时候鼓动众人反对战争。%randombrother%走向那蠢货，一拳把他打进泥里，让他闭了嘴。可惜，这只让人群更加愤怒，一场混战就此爆发。手下毫不留情，把所有胆敢与战团作对的人尽数砍倒。事后，泥里躺满了死人和垂死之人，女人们满脸茫然与悲痛，照料着伤者；副官和他的士兵却不知去了哪里。}
changes.reason: from the weak 表示把强壮者与羸弱者分开，原译变成在羸弱者里面挑出最强壮的人。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]A man in a suit of armor stops you on the path. You put a hand to your sword and order him to announce his intentions, all the while keeping your eyes peeled for an ambush. The stranger takes a step forward and removes his helm.%SPEECH_ON%I am %crusader%, a fighter from a fiery land with no name. I stood upon the hills of evil counsel. I slew the monsters of Dev'ungrad. I gave peace to the spirits at Shellstaya. When the ancients speak, I listen. And so here I am.%SPEECH_OFF%You take your hand off your sword and ask him of the ancients. He nods and speaks.%SPEECH_ON%The men before men, the ancients were suzerain over all things, having forged an empire that stretched to realms far beyond this one. All this chaos is mere fragments of their destruction. A man may die, but an empire does not. An empire decays, piece by piece, and takes with it all that it thinks it is owed.%SPEECH_OFF%The crusader puts his helmet back on and holds his sword up.%SPEECH_ON%The Empire of the Ancients stirs in its grave. I wish to help quiet it. I offer you my sword, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]一个身披全甲的男人在路上拦住你。你把手搭在剑上，命他说明来意，同时警惕地扫视四周，提防埋伏。陌生人上前一步，摘下头盔。%SPEECH_ON%我是%crusader%，来自无名烈焰之地的战士。我曾踏上恶谋丘陵，斩杀德文格勒的怪物，让谢尔斯塔亚的亡魂安息。远古先民开口，我便聆听。于是，我来到了这里。%SPEECH_OFF%你把手从剑上移开，问起那些远古先民。他点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%先民，是人类之前的人。他们曾统御万物，建立的帝国远远超出这片天地。眼前一切混乱，不过是帝国毁灭留下的碎片。人会死，帝国却不会。帝国只是逐渐腐朽，一块接一块，将它认为属于自己的一切，都一并拖走。%SPEECH_OFF%圣战士重新戴上头盔，举起剑。%SPEECH_ON%先民的帝国正在坟墓中翻动。我愿助它归于沉寂。佣兵，我愿为你执剑。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.after: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_35.png[/img]一个身披全甲的男人在路上拦住你。你把手搭在剑上，命他说明来意，同时警惕地扫视四周，提防埋伏。陌生人上前一步，摘下头盔。%SPEECH_ON%我是%crusader%，来自无名烈焰之地的战士。我曾踏上恶谋丘陵，斩杀德文格勒的怪物，让谢尔斯塔亚的亡魂安息。远古先民开口，我便聆听。于是，我来到了这里。%SPEECH_OFF%你把手从剑上移开，问起那些远古先民。他点头说道：%SPEECH_ON%先民，是活在我们之前的人。他们曾统御万物，建立的帝国远远超出这片天地。眼前一切混乱，不过是帝国毁灭留下的碎片。人会死，帝国却不会。帝国只是逐渐腐朽，一块接一块，将它认为属于自己的一切，都一并拖走。%SPEECH_OFF%圣战士重新戴上头盔，举起剑。%SPEECH_ON%先民的帝国正在坟墓中翻动。我愿助它归于沉寂。佣兵，我愿为你执剑。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.reason: The men before men 在先民帝国语境中指生活在今人之前的先人，原译会被读成先于人类存在的物种。

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_02.png[/img] {While marching through the forest, %randombrother% calls out to the company. You look over to see him pointing somewhere beyond a line of brush. When you walk to him, you see what he sees: three bodies hanging from a tree. Their purpled faces and grey feet sway and turn, the wind sometimes forcing them to grimly face one another. %randombrother% notes that they're wearing wood: signs of their crimes. 'Thief,' reads one. 'Whore' another. 'Traitor' the last. Having seen enough, you tell the men to get moving again. | The forest offers no relief, no little road or sidepath for you to travel down. It is thick and unrelenting and does not seem to want you there. You soon find that it did not want someone else, either: a corpse is found tied up in a thorn bush, legs crooked, arms bent, all rather finagled to to their supposed purpose. The mouth rests agape with the eyes drawn slim in some sort of final frustration. %randombrother% catches up to you, looks the body up and down, then nods.%SPEECH_ON%Body's clean as a whistle, aside from the thorn's work of course. I'd say that man right there was so lost no animal could find him. Just died, no use to anyone or anything.%SPEECH_OFF%You point at an ant mindlessly bumbling about the dead man's teeth. The brother laughs and shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%You sure he ain't lost too?%SPEECH_OFF% | You stare up at the forest canopy, watching what angles the lightbeams are coming in at. While getting your bearings, %randombrother% comes by looking rather distraught.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, you oughta come see this.%SPEECH_OFF%You nod and tell him to lead the way. He brings you to a clearing, though not much about it is clear.

Legs. Legs everywhere. Some severed at the ankle, some at the thigh, and everywhere else in between. They've no place, no order. They're just about, some by themselves and others all twisted up in bunches, some planted upright with sticks like they were walking jokes and a few even seem to have been thrown into the trees where they rest limply over branches or upside down by their feet. One hangs from a spit, the calf burnt black as though someone had run off, leaving it there over a fire that had long since died.

The brother that found the disgusting sight comes to stand next to you.%SPEECH_ON%No bodies, sir. Just.. legs.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to look at the mercenary, but all he can do is shrug.%SPEECH_ON%We've not found a single body, sir. I mean, the top-half, anyway. Do you think it means anything? I mean, who would do that? Remove someone's legs and then take off with the rest?%SPEECH_OFF%You shake your head in disbelief. Having seen enough, and having no answer for such questions, you quickly usher the rest of the men away from the clearing and get back to marching. | You stop at a creekbed to wash yourself and get something of a drink, but before you take the first sip %randombrother% grabs your shoulder. He points upriver. A woman's body is face down in the water, her long hair twisting rather lively to the ripples. You thank the sellsword for saving you from any disease the dead press onto the world. | The tree canopy is thick and twisting. Whatever light there is above can barely come through, braids of shadow encompassing your men as they march. But further on ahead you see a pillar of light gleaming into the forest. Naturally, someone else saw it first. And it was the last thing they saw.

In that stroke of light a boy rests with his back up against a tree. His head is aloll and his hands turned up and open. Purple smudges stain his palms. %randombrother% walks up and immediately shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Poison berries. Damned kid didn't stand a chance.%SPEECH_OFF%You turn to the battle brother and inquire if the boy might have gone peacefully. The man shakes his head again. %SPEECH_ON%No.%SPEECH_OFF% | A dead body. Rather, what should be a body. The chest is open and the viscera laid out in all directions, grey and sagging and soft. You can't tell if it was a man or woman, only that it had to have been an adult cut down to much smaller sizes. What creature could have done this work is beyond you, though %randombrother% suggests maybe it was the deed of a very determined man. | You find the body of a woman with its back resting against a tree. There is a knife in her chest, the wound so quickly fatal that she appears to have died while in some motion of life. Above her, another woman swings from a branch. Red are her clothes. The body's head tilts forward as though to stare at her crime, and the rope that hangs her there groans to a muted wind. | You come across some scene of battle. Men, armor, weapons, not a single one of them useable. The dead got that way through some sheer form of brutality you do not wish to learn. Footprints in the earth suggest something big had come through, leaving behind a wake of ruin and calamity, and no urge on your part to follow where those steps go. | Marching along, you find a dead man with a few broken arrows in his back. More puncture wounds where his killer managed to retrieve his ammunition in one piece. The man was carrying a love letter, its destination a woman that had, apparently, already been spoken for. Ah, romance.}

腿。到处都是腿。有的从脚踝截断，有的从大腿截断，还有断在两者之间各处的。它们没有固定位置，也毫无排列章法，就那么四处散着。有的孤零零一条，有的扭成一团；有的用棍子撑得直立，像个会走路的笑话；还有几条似乎被扔上了树，软塌塌搭在枝头，或脚朝上倒挂着。一条腿架在烤叉上，小腿烧得焦黑，仿佛有人将它留在早已熄灭的火上，匆匆跑了。

发现这恶心景象的弟兄站到你身旁。%SPEECH_ON%没有尸体，长官。只有……腿。%SPEECH_OFF%你转头看他，他只能耸肩。%SPEECH_ON%一具尸体都没找到，长官。我是说，上半截。你觉得这有什么含义吗？我是说，谁会这样干？砍掉人的腿，再把剩下的带走？%SPEECH_OFF%你难以置信地摇头。既已看够，也答不上这些问题，你赶紧将其他弟兄带离空地，重新上路。 | 你在溪边停下，洗洗身子，想喝几口水。还没来得及喝，%randombrother%便抓住你的肩膀，指向上游。一具女尸脸朝下漂在水里，长发随涟漪扭动，竟颇有生气。你谢过佣兵，免得自己染上死者散布给世间的病。 | 树冠浓密交错，上方仅有的光线几乎透不下来，编织般的阴影包裹着行进的弟兄们。可前方，有一道光柱照入森林。显然，有人比你们更早看见它，而那也是他看见的最后一样东西。

光柱中，一个男孩背靠树干，脑袋歪垂，双手摊开，掌心朝上，沾着紫色污渍。%randombrother%走近，立即摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%毒浆果。可怜的孩子，一点活路都没了。%SPEECH_OFF%你转向这位战团弟兄，问男孩是否走得安详。那人又摇摇头。 %SPEECH_ON%没有。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一具尸体。或者说，本该是一具尸体的东西。胸膛敞开，内脏向四面铺散，灰白、软塌、松垂。你分不清是男是女，只能确定，那原本是个成年人，如今被肢解成小得多的部分。你想不出什么生物会做出这种事，%randombrother%却说，也许只是一个特别执着的人。 | 你发现一具女尸，背靠树干，胸口插着一把刀。那伤口致命得太快，她仿佛还没做完活着时的一个动作，便已死去。上方，另一个女人吊在树枝上摇晃，衣服染成了红色。尸体低着头，像在凝视自己的罪行，悬着她的绳索在微弱的风中呻吟。 | 你走进一处战斗遗迹。人、盔甲、武器，没有一样还派得上用场。死者遭受过某种极端的暴行，你并不想知道具体是什么。泥土上的足迹表明，有个庞然大物曾经过此地，沿途留下毁灭与灾难，也让你半点不想循着脚印追过去。 | 行军途中，你发现一个死者，背上插着几支断箭。还有更多穿刺伤，说明凶手成功收回了一部分完好的箭。那人身上带着一封情书，收信的女人似乎早已有了归属。啊，爱情。}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]While marching down the road, you find a man with a broken cart by the side of the path. By the wagon there is a donkey standing idle and as defeated as a donkey can look. The trader looks a little better than that and your appearance seems to have scared him. He rears up, backing away momentarily.%SPEECH_ON%Have you come to take my things? If so, you needn't kill me. Take what you want.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]沿路行军时，你发现路边停着一辆坏车，一个男人守在旁边。车旁的驴呆站着，丧气得几乎不像一头驴。商人的模样也好不到哪去，看见你们，更是吓了一跳，连忙往后退。%SPEECH_ON%你们是来抢东西的？要是这样，用不着杀我，想拿什么就拿吧。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.after: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_55.png[/img]沿路行军时，你发现路边停着一辆坏车，一个男人守在旁边。车旁的驴呆站着，一副垂头丧气到了极点的模样。商人的模样也好不到哪去，看见你们，更是吓了一跳，连忙往后退。%SPEECH_ON%你们是来抢东西的？要是这样，用不着杀我，想拿什么就拿吧。%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.reason: as defeated as a donkey can look 表示驴看起来沮丧到极点，不是沮丧得不像驴。修复程度比较误译。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{A true war has plenty of living amongst the casualties and this one is no different: going along a path, you find a large group of refugees huddling together. They were washing themselves in a creek when you discovered them, a party half-naked and half-washed and all-terrified. Mostly women and children, a few elders, and a few men who seem ready to lay down their lives for the rest, no matter how fruitless an effort their defense would be. One such man steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%What is it that you want?%SPEECH_OFF%%aggro_bro% approaches you.%SPEECH_ON%Sir, we could take everything they got, but I'm sure they won't give it up willingly.%SPEECH_OFF%%injured_bro% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%I'd say it ain't worth it. These people been through enough as it is and they've little left to give the world.%SPEECH_OFF% | You come across a band of refugees. Women, children, elders, and a scattering of wide-eyed men. They've little of value, but they still have things worth taking were you to put in the effort. | Refugees. A band of them stringed along the path in a long and filed row. At the sight of you, the head of the suffering centipede rears to a stop and all the bodies slowly shuffle together into a fearful blob. %aggro_bro% suggests killing them and taking what they got, although what they got doesn't appear to be much at all by your measurement.}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_59.png[/img]{真正的战争，受害者中总有许多活人，这一场也不例外。沿路走着，你发现一大群难民挤在一起。撞见他们时，众人正用溪水洗身，一半衣衫未整，一半没洗完，个个惊恐万分。其中大多是妇孺，还有几个老人，以及少数准备舍命保护众人的男人，哪怕这样的抵抗注定徒劳。其中一人站出来。%SPEECH_ON%你想要什么？%SPEECH_OFF%%aggro_bro%凑到你身边。%SPEECH_ON%团长，他们的东西我们全能拿走，不过我敢说，他们不会乖乖交出来。%SPEECH_OFF%%injured_bro%摇头。%SPEECH_ON%我看不值。这些人已经吃够苦头了，没剩多少东西能给这世道榨了。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你遇见一群难民。女人、孩子、老人，还有零星几个瞪大双眼的男人。值钱的东西不多，但若肯费些力气，仍有财物值得拿走。 | 难民。一长队难民沿路延伸。看到你，这条苦难蜈蚣的头部猛地停住，后面的躯体缓缓挤拢，缩成惶恐的一团。%aggro_bro%建议杀光他们，拿走所有东西。可依你看，他们所有的东西，也实在没多少。}

changes.reason: 第一分支的 half-naked and half-washed 是描述众人半裸、洗到一半的状态，原译一半……一半……误分成了两拨人。保留其余分支。

changes.source:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You decide not to tell the nobleman of what is wife is up to. The two lovebirds get dressed and hurry out of the pantry, the stable boy pausing to tell you he'll have that shield ready when you leave the castle. In the meantime, you report to the lord who stays you with a hand.%SPEECH_ON%Ah, you need not worry yourself any longer, sellsword. The goblin was found in the stables. One of the horses kicked it clear across the barn! I'll have to reward the stable boy on the soldiering abilities of his steeds!%SPEECH_OFF%Hmm, of course.

 When you leave the castle, the stable boy is there, a suspiciously shield-shaped sack in his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Here, take this. Hurry. And thanks again, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%You tell him it'd be best if he kept it in his pants from now on. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%Nah. She's worth it. See you later, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before:
[img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你决定不把妻子的所作所为告诉贵族。那对鸳鸯穿好衣服，匆忙走出储藏室；马夫停了一下，保证等你离开城堡时，盾牌一定备好。你先去向领主复命，他抬手打断。%SPEECH_ON%啊，不必再费心了，佣兵。地精在马厩里找到了，一匹马把它踢得横飞过整个棚子！马夫把马养得这么能打，得好好奖赏他！%SPEECH_OFF%嗯，当然。

你离开城堡时，马夫等在那里，手中的袋子形状可疑，实在太像盾牌。%SPEECH_ON%给，拿着，快点。再次谢谢你，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%你劝他往后最好管住裤裆。他摇头。%SPEECH_ON%不，她值得。回见，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]You close the closet door and hurry to %nobleman%. You explain to the nobleman what you've seen. When you finish, he states that the goblin had been found drowning in a sewage stream and has been put out of its misery.%SPEECH_ON%As for the sodomites, yes, what of it? Have you looked around? A fort is a nonsensical place to the urges of a man. Swingin' dicks as far as the eye can see and nowhere to put them. Do I like it? No, of course not. Absolutely disgusting nonsense, truly. But if I punished every instance of this behavior I'd be left with a bunch of scarecrows and farm animals, and I can't even be sure of the latter.%SPEECH_OFF%He waves you off.%SPEECH_ON%The goblin's been taken care of, sellsword, I've little else to speak to you about. However, if you could, please inform the servants that the room in which you found them needs cleaning. I care not to look over taxes in a smog of shite.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_31.png[/img]你关上门，赶去见%nobleman%，向他说明所见。听完后，他说地精已在污水沟中找到，挣扎着快淹死了，卫兵替它结束了痛苦。%SPEECH_ON%至于那两个搞在一起的男人，是啊，那又怎样？你看看四周。堡垒这种地方，根本不管男人的欲望合不合理。满眼都是带把的，却没处泄火。我喜欢吗？不，当然不，简直恶心透顶。可若每次都罚，我手下就只剩稻草人和牲畜了——连牲畜都未必保得住。%SPEECH_OFF%他挥手赶你。%SPEECH_ON%地精已经处理了，佣兵，我没别的可说。不过，劳驾通知仆人，把你发现他们的房间打扫一下。我可不想坐在一团屎臭里核算税款。%SPEECH_OFF%

changes.reason: 原文 A fort is a nonsensical place to the urges of a man，紧接满眼男人却无处泄欲的解释；说的是驻堡生活无法满足欲望，并非堡垒不管欲望是否合理。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%lightweight% steps forward.%SPEECH_ON%Ice? Ice is nothing. You can glide on it like this.%SPEECH_OFF%Without even a pause, the man leaps out onto the frozen pond and skates across its surface. Cracks emerge out from behind him like a wake of imminently bad news, but he remains unperturbed. He swings by the undead knight and grabs the frozen sword. The wiederganger groans as its arm breaks off at the elbow. The man merrily skates his way back to the edge of the pond and presents the sword to you. %otherbrother% steps forward and cracks the wiederganger's frozen arm off the handle like a man breaking a crab claw.%SPEECH_ON%Would ya look at that?%SPEECH_OFF%He crushes the fingers into fragments and in the powdered remains there is a signet. A sword and jewelry, what's not to love about this result?
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_143.png[/img]%lightweight%走上前。%SPEECH_ON%冰？冰算什么。像这样滑过去就行。%SPEECH_OFF%他片刻不停，纵身跃上冰池，沿着冰面滑行。裂纹在身后蔓延，如同坏事将至的尾波，他却毫不在意。滑过亡灵骑士身旁时，他一把抓住冻剑。行尸的胳膊从肘部断开，发出一声呻吟。那人兴高采烈地滑回池边，把剑献给你。%otherbrother%上前，像掰蟹钳一样，把行尸冻住的手臂从剑柄上掰掉。%SPEECH_ON%瞧瞧，这是什么？%SPEECH_OFF%他把手指捏成碎屑，粉末中露出一枚印戒。宝剑加首饰，这结果还有什么不满意？
