changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{When you find %employer%, he's bending an ear to a peasant who is speaking desperately with a hoarse voice. Apparently, greenskins raided a nearby village and took off with prisoners. The nobleman immediately calls upon your services: get those people back... at a price, of course. | %employer% is staring at some maps when you enter his room. A few commanders stand at his side, using sticks as pointers to trace and mark the papered topography. When he sees you, the nobleman immediately beckons you close.%SPEECH_ON%I've got a problem, sellsword. Greenskins have been raiding the lands, as I'm sure you've noticed, but lately we have gotten reports that they took some prisoners. We're not entirely sure where they went, but we know where they were last seen. If you go there, I think you could pick up clues as to where they are now. I hope this interests you, mercenary.%SPEECH_OFF% | You see %employer% and a peasant talking together. A few guards have the peasant by the arms, apparently having dragged him before the nobleman. You assume that some crime was committed, but instead this is simply how %employer% prefers to talk to the riff-raff. The layman's news has it that greenskins raided a local area and made off with some prisoners. They've left enough clues it shouldn't be too hard to find them, were you willing to take the task, that is. | %employer% is found slouched in his chair.%SPEECH_ON%My people are losing faith in me. Word has it that the greenskins aren't just raiding villages, but taking prisoners, and I think that is somehow worse! But perhaps if someone could get those people back, my people would start trusting me again. What say you, sellsword, will you help find those poor lost souls? For proper pay, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found talking to one of his commanders.%SPEECH_ON%We'll get them back, don't you worry.%SPEECH_OFF%Seeing you, the nobleman quickly informs you that there was a large battle with greenskins and, per reports, prisoners were taken. The commander steps forward, thumbs in his belt, a large sword clanking at his side.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, it'd be a great service if you could bring those men back.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is arguing with one of his commanders.%SPEECH_ON%Look, we can't afford to send out anymore men.%SPEECH_OFF%The commander points at you.%SPEECH_ON%What about him?%SPEECH_OFF%You're quickly informed of the situation: there was a large battle with greenskins %direction% from here and prisoners were taken. %employer% doesn't have enough men to go out looking for them and needs a man of your flexibility to do the job. | You find %employer% looking at a map. He points at a spot.%SPEECH_ON%%direction% of here was a large battle with some greenskins. We have reason to believe they took prisoners - and I have reason to believe you can get them back.%SPEECH_OFF% | A guard wobbles to you on crutches. His leg is leaking all over the stone floors.%SPEECH_ON%Hey, you're with the %companyname%, right? %employer% told me to meet you.%SPEECH_OFF%He explains that his men clashed with greenskins %direction% of here and that they possibly made off with a group of prisoners. You ask the man why he isn't getting care.%SPEECH_ON%I, uh, ran from the field. This is my punishment. Don't matter anyhow, the apothecary says I'll be dead within the month. See this? Fair bit ugly, no?%SPEECH_OFF%He gingerly lifts his leg up. Green pustules are bubbling up around the bandages. It is quite ugly. | %employer% is found trying to get an ink bottle back from his dog.%SPEECH_ON%You swallow that yer dead, why don't you understand that you stupid mutt?%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman sees you and straightens up.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! It's good seeing you for these are truly dire times. There was a battle with greenskins %direction% of here and my commanders report that the savages made off with prisoners! I need a man of your services to help get those men back.%SPEECH_OFF%While you mull it over, the dog scarfs down the ink bottle and immediately begins to gag. It comes back up in a stream of blackened vomit. A quill pen gently glides astride the puke. %employer% incredulously raises his hands.%SPEECH_ON%I spent an hour looking for that! It was my favorite you damned dog.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% unfurling a scroll. He reads it dutifully as a pensive scribe looks over his shoulder. The nobleman slams the paper onto his desk and waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%There was a large battle with greenskins %direction% of here and those savages took prisoners! Prisoners, can you believe it?%SPEECH_OFF%Before you can answer, %employer% continues on.%SPEECH_ON%Look, I don't have men to spare, but if it's true that the greenskins took prisoners, then perhaps a man of your capabilities could help get them back?%SPEECH_OFF% | One of %employer%'s commanders meets you outside the door to his room. He hands you a scroll with instructions written on it. Per the report, a large battle %direction% of here ended up with greenskins taking prisoners. %employer% is interested in getting those men back, but doesn't have soldiers to spare with which to rescue them. The commander crosses his arms.%SPEECH_ON%If you wish to negotiate, my liege has delegated me the power to do so.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% kicking a cat around his room, chasing it with his foot wherever he can until the feline takes to the ceiling, clutching tightly to the top of a curtain stalk. The nobleman stares up at it.%SPEECH_ON%I do not think I could ever find the words to state how much I hate that damned thing.%SPEECH_OFF%He turns to see you.%SPEECH_ON%Mercenary! You are a sight for sore eyes! I need something done, and no it's not about that damned critter. My soldiers got into a battle with greenskins %direction% of here. Reports state that the savages took prisoners which means they could possibly be taken back. And I think you, sir, are the man for the job.%SPEECH_OFF%The cat mewls and stoops on its haunches. %employer% wheels around, pointing a finger.%SPEECH_ON%I want you to jump down here! I want you to!%SPEECH_OFF% | There's a group of commanders standing around %employer%. There's also a man's head on the desk before them. %employer% looks at you.%SPEECH_ON%A detachment of soldiers made contact with greenskins %direction% of here. They lost, if you couldn't tell. They also took prisoners and, if that's true, I have a keen interest in getting those men back! I think you're the perfect man for the job, sellsword, so what say you?%SPEECH_OFF% | A skinny kid stands beside %employer%, drawing up a map and explaining a series of events he witnessed with his own eyes: a detachment of soldiers clashed with greenskins %direction% of here and lost. The savages then took prisoners and made off with them. %employer% turns to you.%SPEECH_ON%Well, if what this scrawny peasant says is true, then we need to get those men back. Sellsword, what say you? Are you interested in rescuing my soldiers?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% speaking to a weeping commander.%SPEECH_ON%So, let me get this straight. %direction% of here you ran into a group of greenskins, lost, fled, and watched some of your men be taken prisoner?%SPEECH_OFF%The commander nods. %employer% waves his hand at some guards.%SPEECH_ON%Dishonorable cowardice will find no reward in these halls, take him away! And you, sellsword! I need a man of stronger constitution to go out there and get those prisoners back!%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你找到%employer%时，他正侧耳听一个农民说话。那人嗓音嘶哑，语气绝望。看来，绿皮袭击了附近的村庄，还掳走了一些俘虏。贵族立刻向你提出委托：把那些人带回来……当然，会付钱。 | 你走进%employer%的房间，见他正盯着几张地图。几名指挥官站在身旁，用木棒指点纸上的地形，勾画标记。贵族一见到你，立刻招手让你靠近。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我碰上麻烦了。想必你也注意到，绿皮一直在劫掠各地。可最近我们收到报告，说它们还抓了俘虏。我们不清楚它们去了哪儿，但知道最后一次有人见到它们的地点。我想，你去那里，应该能找到线索，查出它们如今的去向。佣兵，希望你对这事有兴趣。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你看到%employer%正在与一个农民交谈。几名守卫扣住农民的胳膊，显然是把他拖到贵族面前的。你以为这人犯了什么罪，结果只是%employer%喜欢这样跟贱民说话。据那平民所说，绿皮袭击了当地一处地方，还带走了一些俘虏。它们留下的线索不少，应该不难找到——前提是，你愿意接下这桩差事。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正瘫坐在椅子里。%SPEECH_ON%我的百姓正在失去对我的信任。消息说，绿皮不只袭击村庄，还抓了俘虏。我总觉得，这比杀人还糟！不过，要是有人能把那些人救回来，百姓也许就会重新信任我。佣兵，你怎么说？愿意帮忙找回那些可怜人吗？当然，会给你合适的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正与一名指挥官交谈。%SPEECH_ON%我们会把他们救回来的，别担心。%SPEECH_OFF%见到你，贵族很快说明：他们与绿皮打了一场大仗，据报告，有人被俘。指挥官走上前，拇指插在腰带里，身侧的大剑哐当作响。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，要是能把那些人带回来，你可就帮了大忙。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正与一名指挥官争吵。%SPEECH_ON%听着，我们实在抽不出更多人了。%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官指向你。%SPEECH_ON%那他呢？%SPEECH_OFF%你很快得知了情况：在这里的%direction%，他们与绿皮打了一场大仗，有人被抓走。%employer%没有足够的人手去找，需要你这样能灵活行动的人接下这差事。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正在看地图。他指着其中一处。%SPEECH_ON%这里的%direction%，刚与绿皮打过一场大仗。我们有理由相信，它们带走了俘虏。而我有理由相信，你能把人救回来。%SPEECH_OFF% | 一名守卫拄着拐杖，摇摇晃晃地走向你。腿上的伤口不断渗水，滴得到处都是。%SPEECH_ON%嘿，你是%companyname%的人，对吧？%employer%让我来见你。%SPEECH_OFF%他解释说，部下在这里的%direction%与绿皮交战，那些家伙可能掳走了一批俘虏。你问他，为什么没人给他治伤。%SPEECH_ON%我，呃，从战场上逃了。这是惩罚。不过也无所谓了，药师说，我活不过这个月。看见了吗？挺难看的，对吧？%SPEECH_OFF%他小心地抬起腿，绷带周围鼓起一片绿色脓疱。确实很难看。 | 你找到%employer%时，他正想从狗嘴里抢回一瓶墨水。%SPEECH_ON%吞下去你就死定了，怎么就听不懂呢，你这条蠢狗？%SPEECH_OFF%贵族见到你，直起身来。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！这种危急关头，见到你真是太好了。这里的%direction%刚与绿皮打过一仗，我的指挥官报告，那些野蛮东西带走了俘虏！我需要你这样的人，帮忙把他们救回来。%SPEECH_OFF%你正考虑着，那条狗把墨水瓶囫囵吞下，立刻开始干呕。瓶子伴着一股漆黑的呕吐物又返了出来，一支羽毛笔轻轻滑到那滩污物旁。%employer%难以置信地举起双手。%SPEECH_ON%我找了它整整一个时辰！那可是我最喜欢的笔，你这条该死的狗！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正展开一卷文书，认真阅读。一名忧心忡忡的书记员从他肩后看着。贵族把纸重重拍在桌上，招手让你进来。%SPEECH_ON%这里的%direction%，刚与绿皮打过一场大仗，那些野蛮东西抓走了俘虏！俘虏啊，你信吗？%SPEECH_OFF%还没等你回答，%employer%便接着说道。%SPEECH_ON%听着，我抽不出人手，但要是绿皮真的抓了俘虏，像你这样有本事的人，或许能把他们救回来？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%的一名指挥官在房门外与你见面，递给你一卷写着指示的文书。报告说，这里的%direction%发生了一场大战，最后绿皮抓走了俘虏。%employer%想把那些人救回来，却抽不出士兵执行营救。指挥官抱起双臂。%SPEECH_ON%如果你想谈条件，主公已授权我与你商谈。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在房间里追踢一只猫，能踹到哪里就踹到哪里。最后，猫蹿到天花板附近，紧紧扒住窗帘杆顶端。贵族仰头盯着它。%SPEECH_ON%我恐怕永远也找不到合适的话，来形容自己有多讨厌这个该死的东西。%SPEECH_OFF%他转过头，看到了你。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！见到你真让人舒心！我有件事要办，当然，跟那该死的小畜生无关。我的士兵在这里的%direction%与绿皮打了一仗。报告说，野蛮东西带走了俘虏，那就意味着，人还有可能救回来。而我认为，先生，你正是做这事的人。%SPEECH_OFF%猫叫了一声，后腿一蹲。%employer%猛地转身，伸手指着它。%SPEECH_ON%你倒是跳下来啊！我巴不得你跳下来！%SPEECH_OFF% | 一群指挥官围在%employer%身边，他们面前的桌上还摆着一颗人头。%employer%看向你。%SPEECH_ON%一支分队在这里的%direction%遭遇了绿皮。要是你还没看出来，他们输了。那些东西还抓了俘虏。如果属实，我很想把那些人救回来！佣兵，我觉得你再合适不过了。怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF% | 一个瘦小的孩子站在%employer%身边，一边画地图，一边讲述亲眼所见的经过：一支士兵分队在这里的%direction%与绿皮交战，败了。随后，那些野蛮东西抓走俘虏，扬长而去。%employer%转向你。%SPEECH_ON%好吧，要是这个瘦巴巴的农民孩子说的是真的，我们就得把那些人救回来。佣兵，你怎么说？有兴趣营救我的士兵吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正对一名哭泣的指挥官说话。%SPEECH_ON%那么，让我理一理。你在这里的%direction%遇到一群绿皮，打输了，逃了，还看着自己的一些部下被抓走？%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官点头。%employer%向几名守卫挥了挥手。%SPEECH_ON%无耻的怯懦，在我这里得不到奖赏。把他带走！还有你，佣兵！我要一个更有胆量的人，去把那些俘虏救回来！%SPEECH_OFF%}

你找到%employer%时，他正对一名哭泣的指挥官说话。%SPEECH_ON%那么，让我理一理。你在这里的%direction%方遇到一群绿皮，打输了，逃了，还看着自己的一些部下被抓走？%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官点头。%employer%向几名守卫挥了挥手。%SPEECH_ON%无耻的怯懦，在我这里得不到奖赏。把他带走！还有你，佣兵！我要一个更有胆量的人，去把那些俘虏救回来！%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.reason: Direction8 实际值不带方、边；“这里的北/这里北的”等静态位置拼接缺少方位后缀，按本句语气补足“方/边”，覆盖本条全部相关随机分支。同时合入 time-corrections.json 已确认的 an hour：一个时辰→一个小时，避免集成时同 key 覆盖。；原文 I spent an hour looking for that 明确是寻找羽毛笔花了一小时；一个时辰通常为两小时，时长被翻倍。

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer% is surrounded by his military men. They're wearing a great deal of pompous clothes that make you think they're a little outside their element taking on war. However, despite the rather feathery appearance, one of the commanders takes you aside with a map and speaks clearly.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, we need you to travel to an abandoned fortress %direction% from here. We have a wing of soldiers marching to the location, but they will not beat the northern savages to it. Of anyone within reach, you are the closest. Go there and defend until our soldiers show. The fortification is decrepit, but I believe a man of your conniving nature can make do with a bit of rubble if he needs to. %reward% crowns will wait upon your return, and your success, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% sits on a pillow with a huge rug spread out before him. Well-dressed lieutenants sit around the corners, each armed with a long wooden stick to push pieces around. And at the length of the rug are a few carpetmakers still adding to the map - as far as you can tell they are adding sections of the north. The Vizier sees you and speaks from a distance.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, there lies a fort %direction% of here. It is a fallen fortress, made of little more than rubble some say, but the ancients built it there for good reason: it is of great strategic importance. While I have soldiers moving swiftly to its location, they will not arrive before a contingent of northerners do. Unclean savages they are, you have to respect their wile in advancing rapidly. So, I need you to occupy the fortress and hold off the northerners until my armies there.%SPEECH_OFF%He holds up a piece of paper with a number you can understand easily: %reward% crowns. | A very tall man in military garb heads you off from entering %employer%'s room. The Vizier can be heard mingling with his harem, but that's not your business. The lieutenant presses a scroll into your chest.%SPEECH_ON%The ancients built a fortress %direction% from here. It has since fallen apart, weak as all things are to the passage of time, but its location still proves strategic. We are currently moving a troop of soldiers to the location, but our scouts have relayed that the northern dogs are as aware of its import and will beat us there. That is where you come in. %reward% crowns to commandeer the fort and hold it until help arrives. Once relieved, you return to us and earn a good little Crowling's pay.%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer%身边围着一群军官。他们衣着华丽得过了头，叫你怀疑这些人打仗是不是行家。不过，其中一位指挥官虽然满身羽饰，拿着地图把你带到一旁后，说话却十分清楚。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，我们要你前往这里%direction%的一座废弃要塞。已有一支部队朝那里行军，但无法赶在北方蛮子前面抵达。眼下能调动的人里，你离得最近。去那里守住，直到我们的士兵到来。工事虽然破败，可我相信，凭你这种人的狡黠，必要时几块碎石也能派上用场。回来后有%reward%克朗等着你——当然，得事成才行。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%坐在软垫上，面前铺着一张巨大的地毯。衣着考究的副将围坐四角，各拿一根长木杆，推移上面的棋子。地毯尽头还有几个织毯工，正继续添补地图；据你所见，他们织的是北方的部分。维齐尔看见你，远远开口。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，这里的%direction%有座要塞，早已倾颓，据说几乎只剩瓦砾。但古人把它建在那里，自有道理：那地方极具战略价值。我的士兵正全速赶往那里，却赶不上一支北方部队。那群肮脏蛮夷，快速推进的本事倒不得不认。所以，我要你先占住要塞，挡住北方人，等我的军队抵达。%SPEECH_OFF%他举起一张纸，上面的数字你一看就懂：%reward%克朗。 | 你正要走进%employer%的房间，一个穿军服的高个子男人将你拦下。屋里传来维齐尔与姬妾调笑的声音，但那与你无关。副将将一卷文书按在你胸前。%SPEECH_ON%古人在这里的%direction%建过一座要塞。岁月面前，万物皆弱，它如今也已倾颓，可位置仍有战略价值。我们正在派兵前往，侦察兵却回报，北方狗也知道那里的重要，会比我们先到。你的用处就在这里。%reward%克朗，抢占要塞，坚守到援军抵达。有人接防后，你就回来，领一个乖克朗客应得的报酬。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer% welcomes you into his room which is a space of ultimate luxury - there are numerous fineries ranging from silks, pelts, women, and gems. So many gems.%SPEECH_ON%Crownling, about time you'd come here. We have an economic matter that needs settling. Serpents are nastily assailing the population near wetlands %direction% of here. But more importantly, we desire the scales of these serpents. They make the utmost...%SPEECH_OFF%The man kisses his fingers.%SPEECH_ON%Bags and shoes. Look at these women, do they not show their desire for said scales?%SPEECH_OFF%The women are staring at their hands or talking amongst themselves. The Vizier claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Handbags, my sweet, beautiful doves, handbags made from serpent scales! Yes, smile. There you go. See? How hard was that? Alright, Crownling. The offer to return these scales is %reward% crowns. For such a price do you agree to dispatch yourself upon this task?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% petting a wildly tall bird with pink feathers and long black legs. He is feeding it crickets, which the bird doesn't seem to much care for.%SPEECH_ON%Ahh, I have spoiled you, Little Doveling.%SPEECH_OFF%He begins to feed the strange creature long silvered fish which he pulls, alive, out of a golden bucket. He talks without looking at you as the bird gulps down fish after fish.%SPEECH_ON%We here have acquired knowledge that serpents are in the wetlands %direction% of here. The scales of said serpents is worth a considerable amount, not in gold, of course, but in our fine tastes. We desire that you head there and herd said scales into your backpacks and trot your little legs back here.%SPEECH_OFF%The man raises a finger, raises it even further, then points it at the tiles beneath his feet.%SPEECH_ON%And for that, we will pay you %reward% crowns.%SPEECH_OFF%The pink bird prunes itself and seemingly stares at you in the stead of its caretaker. | %employer% is setting on what seems like the ledge of a sauna, but his feet are buried in the hands of women laying in what is some sort of indoor aqueduct. They are using reeds to breathe, and from what you can tell they are massaging the man's feet. It is an absurd sight, but the Vizier pays it as much mind as he does you.%SPEECH_ON%Ah the Crownling arrives. We desire, as we always have desired, the scales of serpents for which we use to gild our luxuries. These scales can be found upon the serpents, who themselves, hmmm, yes, can be found %direction% of here. In the, ahhh, wetlands.%SPEECH_OFF%The man leans back and briefly raises his toes out of water. They wiggle as he stares at you.%SPEECH_ON%The offer is %reward% crowns, are you in agreement with such a fine, fair offer?%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_162.png[/img]{%employer%将你迎进房间，里面奢华到了极点：丝绸、皮毛、女人、宝石，应有尽有。尤其是宝石，多得惊人。%SPEECH_ON%克朗客，你总算来了。我们有桩生意上的事需要解决。这里%direction%的湿地附近，巨蛇正在凶残地袭击居民。不过，更要紧的是，我们想要这些巨蛇的鳞片。用来制作那种最绝妙的……%SPEECH_OFF%男人亲吻了一下自己的指尖。%SPEECH_ON%包和鞋。看看这些女人，难道她们还没流露出对蛇鳞的渴望吗？%SPEECH_OFF%女人们不是低头看手，就是彼此闲聊。维齐尔拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%手提包，我甜美、漂亮的小鸽子们，用巨蛇鳞片做的手提包！对，笑一笑。这就对了。看见了吗？有那么难吗？好了，克朗客。把蛇鳞带回来，酬金%reward%克朗。这个价钱，你愿意接下差事吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正抚摸一只高得惊人的鸟，粉红羽毛，漆黑长腿。他喂它蟋蟀，鸟却似乎没多大兴趣。%SPEECH_ON%啊，我把你宠坏了，小鸽儿。%SPEECH_OFF%他改从金桶里捞出一条条细长的银鱼，活着喂给这只怪鸟。鸟接连吞鱼，他一边说话，眼睛却不看你。%SPEECH_ON%我们已经得知，这里%direction%的湿地中有巨蛇出没。这些蛇的鳞片价值不菲，当然，我指的不是黄金，而是它们符合我们的高雅品味。我们希望你前往那里，将鳞片收进背包，再迈着你的小腿跑回来。%SPEECH_OFF%男人竖起一根手指，又举高些，最后指向脚下的地砖。%SPEECH_ON%为此，我们会付你%reward%克朗。%SPEECH_OFF%粉红色的鸟梳理着羽毛，似乎代替照料它的人，打量起你来。 | %employer%坐在一处像是蒸浴池边沿的地方，双脚埋在女人们的手中。那些女人躺在一道室内水渠里，用芦管呼吸。依你所见，她们是在替他按摩双脚。这景象荒唐至极，维齐尔却毫不在意，正如他并不在意你。%SPEECH_ON%啊，克朗客来了。我们想要巨蛇的鳞片，一向都想要，用它们装点我们的奢华生活。这些鳞片长在巨蛇身上，至于巨蛇，嗯，对，就在这里的%direction%。在那片，啊……湿地。%SPEECH_OFF%男人向后靠了靠，将脚趾短暂地抬出水面，一边扭动，一边看着你。%SPEECH_ON%出价%reward%克朗，如此优厚、公道的条件，你同意吗？%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{You find %employer% helping a young noble boy aim a bow downrange at a strawman. He straightens the kid's back and orders him to breathe deep before shooting. The amateur archer nods and does as told. The arrow is loosed. It wobbles, caroms off the ground, and rattles spinning into a stable where a few horses whinny at the scary disturbance. The nobleman claps the boy on the back.%SPEECH_ON%Trust me, I was worse on my first go. Keep at it. I'll be back in a moment.%SPEECH_OFF%The nobleman approaches you, shaking his head and lowering his voice.%SPEECH_ON%Things are dire, mercenary. The young know not of what dangers lurk these days, but you do. We have a settlement, %objective% just %direction% of here, that is surrounded by... well, the ills of this world. I've no men to spare, but that's where you come in. Go there and save the village and you'll be paid very well, I can assure you!%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found staring at one of his swords. He has it unsheathed, staring at his face in the steeled reflection.%SPEECH_ON%When I was taught how to use one of these, it was meant for men. Now? People speak of the dead, of greenskins, beasts beyond measure!%SPEECH_OFF%He slams the sword to the hilt and throws it and the scabbard on his table. He runs his hand through his hair.%SPEECH_ON%%objective% %direction% of here needs your help. It has been surrounded by these... these things! I know not what they are, only that they kill and kill and kill! I've not a man to spare, but if you go there and help this town then you will be rewarded most handsomely!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% sitting between an abbot and a scribe who are yelling at each other in jowl-shaking, teeth-rattling old man voices. Given that the dead are arisen, questions of both mortality and life-after-death have become rather furiously debated. The nobleman sees you and jumps to his feet. He hurries to you, the argument raging in the background.%SPEECH_ON%Thank the old gods you are here, mercenary. Just %direction% of here, %objective% is under siege by an army of horribles. Undead, foul things, I don't know, I just know I don't have the men to protect the town myself. Go there and ensure those people are safe and I will pay you well!%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% overseeing a group of sextons lowering a casket into the ground. The coffin is firmly nailed shut, almost hurriedly so: nails corkscrew and bend off the wood, and there are scrape marks along the sides. Seeing you, the nobleman comes over.%SPEECH_ON%The resident of said box decided to come back out. Killed a child and a dog. Almost killed another before the guards put it back down.%SPEECH_OFF%A splurge of black liquid gushes from the bottom of the coffin. The gravediggers jump away, dropping the crate right into its grave with a heavy clatter. %employer% shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%With all these 'undead' outbreaks, my forces have been spread thin. I've just gotten word that %objective% just %direction% of here is another one to become under attack. Sellsword, would you go there and help save it?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% studying a crop of books scattered across his desk. He's shaking his head, every twist of the neck seemingly turning another page. Upset, he hurriedly waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Don't dally, sellsword, we've no time for that. I need you to go to %objective% %direction% of here. My birds tell me it's under assault, more of these damned 'dead' come to life, if that's really the way to say it. Are you interested in going? The pay will more than compensate your efforts.%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% watching over some masons putting sharply cut stones together. He shakes your hand.%SPEECH_ON%Building another monastery, sellsword, how does it look?%SPEECH_OFF%It looks good, but you point out that there is another abbey right across the road. The nobleman smirks.%SPEECH_ON%The dead are walking the earth again, there ain't enough pews around to sit the scared folk. Listen, I called you here because my forces are spread thin trying to handle this... oddity of undeath. There's a town just %direction% of here, %objective%, that desperately needs help. My birds tell me it's under attack and you seem just the man who'd be interested in saving it. For a price, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%, a treasurer, and a commander are talking. The treasurer says there's plenty of crowns, but the commander bluntly states that there are no men around with which to pay to fight. You, like the devil you are, enter the room and are immediately spoken of.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! Your services are needed immediately! We have a village %direction% of here, a little place called %objective%, that is under attack by these, er, what are they?%SPEECH_OFF%The commander leans toward the nobleman and whispers the answer. He rears back.%SPEECH_ON%Under attack by the... 'undead.' Sure. Would you be willing to go there and protect those poor people?%SPEECH_OFF% | You eventually find %employer% out in his stables. He's putting a saddle on a horse and soon realizes that you're keeping your distance.%SPEECH_ON%Scared are we, sellsword?%SPEECH_OFF%Shrugging, you tell him you've never cared for the beasts. The nobleman shrugs in return and mounts, swinging his legs over the cantle.%SPEECH_ON%Suit yourself. My birds have told me of %objective%'s troubles, those troubles being a great horde of undead knocking on its doors and I don't think they're delivering milk to those townspeople. If you go there and help protect the village, there will be a stout satchel of pay waiting for you here on your return.%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is found walking the walls of his fortification. The guards around him are unusually shaped up, straight backed, dutiful eyes looking for danger. Seeing you, the nobleman waves you over. Together, you stare between the crenelations. The land spreads out before you, enormous forests turned into mere dots, mountains into arrowhead, birds arcing in thick formations.%SPEECH_ON%%direction% of here lies %objective%. Messengers told me that it is under attack by some unbelievable force, undead to be exact. Yes, that unbelievable. Whatever assails their walls, I have not the men to handle it. But you, sellsword, your services would be most appropriate here. Would you be interested?%SPEECH_OFF% | You find %employer% and a gaunt scribe staring at a headless corpse laid across a slab of stone. The head is in a corner, the eyeballs slanted, steel rods standing out of its half-carved skull. Seeing you, the nobleman offers an inviting hand.%SPEECH_ON%Nothing to fear, sellsword. As I'm sure you've heard, the dead are walking the earth again and with that comes a great deal of speculation as to why.%SPEECH_OFF%The scribe looks up, interrupting.%SPEECH_ON%Or how...%SPEECH_OFF%Smiling, the nobleman continues.%SPEECH_ON%Anyway, %objective% %direction% of here is being assaulted by these very monsters, er, former humans? But I've not the men to send relief. You, however, are perfect for the job. Would you be willing to take it?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is listening to the whispers of a scribe when you enter his room. The scribe glances at you with jaundiced eyes before continuing his talk. When he finishes, both men nod and the elder leaves. He doesn't so much as look at you as he goes. %employer% calls out.%SPEECH_ON%Glad you are here, sellsword! These are indeed dire times. My men are spread across the land handling all manner of monstrous evils. I'm sure you have heard already, but the 'dead', or whatever they are, walk again. And they're assaulting %objective% %direction% of here. With no men to spare, I depend upon your services, sellsword. Would you help save this town?%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer% is listening to the pleas of a group of peasants. You've only arrived for the tail-end of the conversation as the nobleman angrily waves them off. As the laymen shout, guards close ranks to escort them out, peacefully for now, violently if they so wish. They go out the door without further protests, though one peasant glances at you and mouths 'help us' before turning away. %employer% waves his hand.%SPEECH_ON%Well, hell, if it isn't the sellsword! Right on time, my money-grubbing friend. I've a town %direction% of here, %objective%, which is in dire need of help. It is currently, so they say anyway, under siege by the undead. There's a large satchel of crowns waiting for you here if you go there and help defend it. What do you say, hm?%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_45.png[/img]{你找到%employer%时，他正在教一个贵族男孩张弓，瞄准远处的稻草人。他扶直孩子的背，让他放箭前深吸一口气。小弓手点头照做，箭离弦而去，歪歪斜斜地撞到地面，翻滚着弹进马厩，吓得几匹马连声嘶鸣。贵族拍了拍男孩的背。%SPEECH_ON%相信我，我头一次射得比你还差。继续练，我一会儿就回来。%SPEECH_OFF%贵族走向你，摇摇头，压低声音。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，形势危急。年轻人不知道如今四处潜伏着什么危险，你却知道。这里的%direction%，有个聚落叫%objective%，正被……唉，被这世上的邪祟围困。我抽不出兵，只能靠你。去那里救下村子，我保证，报酬绝对丰厚！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在端详自己的一把剑。剑已出鞘，他盯着钢刃上映出的脸。%SPEECH_ON%当年我学着用这东西，是为了对付人。现在呢？人人都在说死人、绿皮，还有数不清的怪兽！%SPEECH_OFF%他猛地将剑插回鞘中，连剑带鞘扔到桌上，伸手捋过头发。%SPEECH_ON%这里的%direction%，%objective%需要你帮助。那里被这些……这些东西包围了！我不知道它们究竟是什么，只知道它们不停地杀，杀，杀！我一个人也抽不出来。但你若肯去救这座镇子，就能得到极其丰厚的酬劳！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正坐在一位修道院长和一名书记员中间。两个老人扯着嗓子对吼，腮肉乱颤，牙齿打战。死人重新站起来之后，生死与死后世界的问题，也吵得愈发激烈。贵族见到你，立刻跳起身，快步走来，身后的争论仍在继续。%SPEECH_ON%谢天谢地，旧神把你送来了，佣兵。这里的%direction%，%objective%正被一支可怕的大军围攻。亡灵、邪物，究竟是什么，我不知道。我只知道，自己没人手保护那座镇子。去那里，保住那些百姓，我会好好付钱！%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正看着一群教堂杂役把棺材放进土里。棺盖钉得死死的，显然十分匆忙：钉子扭曲弯折，支在木板外面，棺身两侧还留着抓痕。贵族看见你，走了过来。%SPEECH_ON%这箱子里的住客，决定再出来走一趟。杀了一个孩子、一条狗，差点又杀一个，守卫才把它放倒。%SPEECH_OFF%一股黑色液体从棺底涌出，掘墓人吓得跳开，棺材重重掉进墓穴。%employer%摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%“亡灵”到处冒出来，我的兵力早已捉襟见肘。刚接到消息，这里的%direction%，%objective%也遭到了袭击。佣兵，你愿意去帮忙救下那里吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在研究散落桌上的一堆书。他不停摇头，仿佛每转一下脖子，就又翻过一页。心烦意乱的他急忙招手让你进去。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，别磨蹭，我们没那个工夫。我要你去这里的%direction%，去%objective%。我的小鸟说，那里正遭受进攻，又是那些该死的“死人”活了过来——如果真该这么形容的话。你有兴趣去吗？报酬绝对对得起你的辛苦。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在监督石匠垒砌棱角分明的石块。他与你握手。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我们又在建一座修道院。看着怎么样？%SPEECH_OFF%看着不错，但你指出，路对面就有一座修道院。贵族一笑。%SPEECH_ON%死人又开始满地走，吓坏的人太多，祈祷用的长椅都不够坐了。听着，我叫你来，是因为要应付这种……死而复生的怪事，手下兵力已经四处分散。这里的%direction%，有座镇子叫%objective%，急需援助。我的小鸟说，那里正在遭受袭击。我看，你正是会有兴趣去救它的人。当然，是有偿的。%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正在与一名财务官和一名指挥官交谈。财务官说，克朗多的是，指挥官却直言，没有人可供雇来打仗。说到需要佣兵，你这个逐利的魔鬼便恰好进了门，立刻成了众人谈论的对象。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！我们急需你的帮助！这里的%direction%有个村子，一个叫%objective%的小地方，正被那些，呃，那是什么来着？%SPEECH_OFF%指挥官凑向贵族，低声告诉他答案。他向后一仰。%SPEECH_ON%正被……“亡灵”袭击。对。你愿意去保护那些可怜人吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你最终在马厩里找到%employer%。他正给马装鞍，很快注意到你始终隔着一段距离。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，怕了吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你耸耸肩，说自己从来就不喜欢这些牲口。贵族也耸耸肩，抬腿越过鞍后，翻身上马。%SPEECH_ON%随你。我的小鸟告诉我，%objective%有麻烦了。所谓麻烦，就是一大群亡灵正在敲门，而我不觉得它们是去给镇民送奶的。你若肯去保护村子，等你回来，这里就会有一只鼓鼓的钱袋等着你。%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%时，他正在要塞城墙上巡视。身边守卫比平时更加齐整，腰杆挺直，眼睛尽职地搜寻危险。贵族见到你，招手叫你过去。你们一起从垛口间望向远方，大地铺展在脚下，广袤的森林缩成小点，山峦化作箭头，鸟群密密地掠过天空。%SPEECH_ON%这里的%direction%是%objective%。信使说，那里正遭受一种难以置信的力量袭击，确切地说，是亡灵。对，就是那么难以置信。不管什么东西正在攻打那里的城墙，我都没有人手应付。但你，佣兵，你的本事在这儿正合适。有兴趣吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你找到%employer%和一名消瘦的书记员，两人正盯着石板上的无头尸体。脑袋放在角落，眼球歪斜，剖开一半的头骨里插着钢钎。贵族见你来了，伸手相请。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，没什么可怕的。想必你也听说了，死人又在世上行走。至于为什么会这样，猜测自然不少。%SPEECH_OFF%书记员抬头插话。%SPEECH_ON%还有，是怎么做到的……%SPEECH_OFF%贵族笑着继续说道。%SPEECH_ON%总之，这里的%direction%，%objective%正在遭受这些怪物——呃，曾经的人类？——袭击。可我派不出援兵。你倒是最合适的人选。愿意接下这桩差事吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | 你走进房间时，%employer%正听一名书记员低语。老人用泛黄的眼睛瞥了你一眼，继续说话。说完，两人一同点头，老人转身离开，经过时看都没再看你。%employer%开口招呼。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，你来了真好！眼下确实危急。我的士兵分散各地，正应付各种可怕的邪物。想必你也听说了，“死人”，或者不管它们是什么，又开始走动。它们正在攻打%objective%，就在这里的%direction%。我抽不出人，只能指望你了，佣兵。你愿意帮忙救下这座镇子吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | %employer%正在听一群农民哀求。你只赶上谈话的尾声，贵族已经恼怒地挥手赶人。平民们叫喊着，守卫收拢队列，准备将他们送出去。眼下还能客气相送，若非要闹，也可以动粗。人们没再争辩，走向门外，不过其中一个农民看了你一眼，无声地说了句“救救我们”，才转身离开。%employer%挥挥手。%SPEECH_ON%哈，这不是佣兵吗！来得正好，我那爱钱的朋友。这里的%direction%，我有座镇子叫%objective%，急需帮助。眼下那里正被亡灵围攻，至少，他们是这么说的。你若去帮忙守住它，这里就会有一大袋克朗等着你。怎么样，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%}

%employer%正在听一群农民哀求。你只赶上谈话的尾声，贵族已经恼怒地挥手赶人。平民们叫喊着，守卫收拢队列，准备将他们送出去。眼下还能客气相送，若非要闹，也可以动粗。人们没再争辩，走向门外，不过其中一个农民看了你一眼，无声地说了句“救救我们”，才转身离开。%employer%挥挥手。%SPEECH_ON%哈，这不是佣兵吗！来得正好，我那爱钱的朋友。这里的%direction%方，我有座镇子叫%objective%，急需帮助。眼下那里正被亡灵围攻，至少，他们是这么说的。你若去帮忙守住它，这里就会有一大袋克朗等着你。怎么样，嗯？%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%employer% welcomes you and walks you toward %townname%'s square. There's a party of peasants milling about, but when they see you coming they shape up and start talking as though they'd been expecting you all along. They mostly talk in descriptors: tall as any man! Armor like you'd never seen before! Spears as sharp as a peddler's tongue! You hold your hand up and ask what it is they are talking about. %employer% laughs.%SPEECH_ON%The men here say they saw some oddities out in a spot by the name of %location% just %direction% of here. Naturally, they weren't out there for no reason. They were looking for something by the name of %item%, a relic dear to the town for through it we pray for food and shelter.%SPEECH_OFF%One of the peasants speak up.%SPEECH_ON%And we was lookin' fer it at his behest!%SPEECH_OFF%%employer% nods.%SPEECH_ON%Of course. And where they failed, perhaps you can succeed? Get this relic for me and you'll be paid quite well for your services. Pay no mind to their fairy tales. I'm sure there's nothing to worry about.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]%employer% welcomes you into his room and pours you a mug of water. He hands it over with a sheepish smile.%SPEECH_ON%I'd offer a bit of ale or wine if I had it on me, but you know how things are nowadays.%SPEECH_OFF%He takes a sip and clears his throat.%SPEECH_ON%Of course, what I'm not short on are crowns, otherwise we wouldn't be having this conversation, right? I need you to go to a place by the name of %location% just %direction% of here and retrieve a relic by the name of %item%. Pretty simple, no?%SPEECH_OFF%You ask what this relic is good for. The man explains.%SPEECH_ON%Townsfolk pray to it. Through it they find peace, call for the rains, fark their goats, I don't care. They believe in it and it keeps them motivated. For that alone it's worth retrieving.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]You step into %employer%'s room to find the man staring at a map of the hinterlands. He shakes his head.%SPEECH_ON%See this spot right here? That's %location%. %townname% used to worship a relic by the name of %item%, but the townsfolk are saying it's gone missing and, well, for whatever reason they think it's there. I've no men to hire and see, for the roads are dangerous and I can't afford to pay for failure, but you, sellsword, seem up to the task. Would you go there and find this %item% for us?%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]You find %employer% talking to a group of peasants. Seeing you, he quiets them all down.%SPEECH_ON%Shush, the lot of you. This man here can solve our problem.%SPEECH_OFF%The townsman takes you aside.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword, we have a bit of a problem. There's a relic I need finding, some such thing by the name of %item%. I don't really give a good old gods damn about it, but these people worship it for spring rains and winter shelter. Naturally, it's gone missing. And for whatever reason folks think it's gone off to a place by the name of %location% all on its own. Nobody'll go there, but you will, yes? For the right price, of course.%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]You find %employer% talking to a druidic monk cloaked in shapes more familiar to beasts than man. Horns for a helmet, bearskin for armor, and the hooves of deer clattering around his chest in a brutish necklace. He's quite the sight. Seeing you, %employer% waves you in.%SPEECH_ON%Sellsword! It is good to see you--%SPEECH_OFF%The druid pushes the man out of the way mid-talk. He speaks with a wobble in his voice, as though he were speaking from the depths of a cavern.%SPEECH_ON%A mercenary, ha! Surely you are a man of faith, no? We of %townname% have lost the %item%. This relic is of great import to us, for through it we can speak to the old gods and have our prayers answered. It's been stolen away, in some manner or another, to the %location%. Go there and retrieve it.%SPEECH_OFF%You glance at %employer% who nods.%SPEECH_ON%Aye, what he said.%SPEECH_OFF%}
changes.before: {[img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]%employer%欢迎你到来，带你走向%townname%的广场。一群农民正在闲逛，见你走来，便立刻站得规矩，七嘴八舌说起来，仿佛一直就在等你。说的多半是些形容：比谁都高！从没见过那样的铠甲！长矛像小贩的舌头一样锋利！你抬手，问他们到底在说什么。%employer%笑了。%SPEECH_ON%这些人说，他们在这里%direction%一个叫%location%的地方，看见了些怪东西。当然，他们不是无缘无故跑去的。他们在找%item%，那是镇上珍视的圣物，我们靠它祈求衣食与庇护。%SPEECH_OFF%一个农民插嘴。%SPEECH_ON%而且，是他吩咐我们去找的！%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%点点头。%SPEECH_ON%当然。他们没办成的事，也许你能办到？替我取回这件圣物，我会付你丰厚的报酬。别在意他们那些神怪故事，肯定没什么可担心的。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]%employer%请你进屋，倒了一杯水，略带腼腆地笑着递来。%SPEECH_ON%手边要是有麦酒或葡萄酒，我就拿来招待了。不过，如今的光景，你也知道。%SPEECH_OFF%他喝了一口，清清嗓子。%SPEECH_ON%当然，克朗我可不缺，不然咱们也不会坐在这里谈，对吧？我要你去这里%direction%一处名叫%location%的地方，取回一件名为%item%的圣物。很简单，不是吗？%SPEECH_OFF%你问，这圣物有什么用。他解释道。%SPEECH_ON%镇民朝它祈祷，靠它求得安宁、求雨，或是和山羊乱搞，我不在乎。他们信它，有了它就有干劲。光凭这一点，也值得找回来。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]你走进%employer%的房间，发现他正盯着一张腹地地图，摇了摇头。%SPEECH_ON%看见这里了吗？这是%location%。%townname%一直供奉一件名为%item%的圣物，可镇民说它不见了。不知怎么，他们觉得它就在那儿。道路危险，我手头没有合适的人能雇去查探，也承担不起白花钱的损失。不过你，佣兵，看起来办得成。愿意去替我们找回%item%吗？%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_43.png[/img]你找到%employer%时，他正和一群农民说话。见你到来，他叫众人安静。%SPEECH_ON%嘘，都别吵。这位能解决我们的问题。%SPEECH_OFF%他把你拉到一旁。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，我们有点麻烦。我需要找回一件圣物，好像叫%item%。说真的，旧神作证，我一点也不在乎它，可这些人供奉它，求春雨，求冬天的容身处。偏巧，它不见了。而且不知为什么，大家觉得它自己跑去了一个叫%location%的地方。没人肯去，可你会去，对吧？当然，价钱得合适。%SPEECH_OFF% | [img]gfx/ui/events/event_62.png[/img]你找到%employer%时，他正与一名德鲁伊修士交谈。那人身上的装束，与其说属于人，倒更像属于野兽：兽角作盔，熊皮作甲，胸前挂着鹿蹄串成的粗野项链，彼此碰得咔哒作响。实在惹眼。见你到来，%employer%招手让你过去。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵！见到你真好——%SPEECH_OFF%话说一半，德鲁伊便把他推到旁边。那人开口时声音颤动，仿佛从洞穴深处传来。%SPEECH_ON%佣兵，哈！你想必也是个有信仰的人，对吧？我们%townname%遗失了%item%。这件圣物对我们至关重要，借助它，我们才能与旧神沟通，让祈祷得到回应。它不知被人用什么手段偷去了%location%。去那里，把它取回来。%SPEECH_OFF%你看向%employer%，他点了点头。%SPEECH_ON%对，就照他说的。%SPEECH_OFF%}

changes.source: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]%employer% is pacing back and forth when you find him. The healer who'd damn near killed you with the firepoke is standing nearby. He's picking chunks of dried blood out of his fingernails. %employer% claps his hands.%SPEECH_ON%Finally, you're here. I have good news! We got hold of one of Hoggart's former men! My good friend here had a nice little talk with the man and now I know where Hoggart's licking his wounds.%SPEECH_OFF%The healer clears his throat, splaying his fingers out like a maiden looking to paint them. He speaks as though he's identifying a disease he is about to excise.%SPEECH_ON%The brigand known as Hoggart is hiding in a small hut %terrain% to the %direction% of here. Based upon my most civil discussion with one of his men, Hoggart knows the  %companyname% is on his heels and will have gathered more men since the last time you met him.%SPEECH_OFF%Nodding, %employer% waves you off.%SPEECH_ON%Good luck, sellsword.%SPEECH_OFF%
changes.before: [img]gfx/ui/events/event_79.png[/img]找到%employer%时，他正来回踱步。那个拿烧红铁钎差点要了你命的医师也站在一旁，抠着指甲缝里的干血块。%employer%拍了拍手。%SPEECH_ON%你总算来了。有好消息！我们抓到了霍加特从前的一个手下！我这位好朋友同他好好聊了一场，如今我知道霍加特躲在哪儿舔伤口了。%SPEECH_OFF%医师清了清嗓子，张开手指，像个准备涂指甲的姑娘。他开口时，那语气仿佛在诊断一种即将切除的病症。%SPEECH_ON%那个叫霍加特的强盗，藏在此地%direction%方向的一间小屋里，就在%terrain%。根据我与他一名手下极其文明的交谈，霍加特知道%companyname%正紧追不舍，想必已比你们上次见面时又招了更多人。%SPEECH_OFF%%employer%点点头，挥手示意你出发。%SPEECH_ON%祝你好运，佣兵。%SPEECH_OFF%

changes.source: %terrainImage%{An hour or so after sending the men off on a hunt, they return. Except they're dragging a bloodied and shredded %bearbrother% back into camp. They report the group had crossed paths with a momma brown bear. Her fight was tremendous, and she only stopped mauling the wounded poacher because one of the men threatened her babies with a torch. You're happy the men are all alive, albeit %bearbrother% is going to require a long time to recover.}
changes.before: %terrainImage%{派弟兄们出去打猎约一个时辰后，他们回来了，却拖着浑身是血、皮开肉绽的%bearbrother%。据说一行人撞见了一头带崽的棕熊。母熊凶悍至极，直到有人举火把威胁幼崽，它才停止撕咬受伤的偷猎者。你庆幸无人丧命，不过%bearbrother%恐怕得养上很久。}
changes.after: %terrainImage%{派弟兄们出去打猎约一个小时后，他们回来了，却拖着浑身是血、皮开肉绽的%bearbrother%。据说一行人撞见了一头带崽的棕熊。母熊凶悍至极，直到有人举火把威胁幼崽，它才停止撕咬受伤的偷猎者。你庆幸无人丧命，不过%bearbrother%恐怕得养上很久。}
changes.reason: 原文 An hour or so 指约一小时；约一个时辰约等于两小时，虽有约数修饰仍偏离原文基准时长。

continuation_note: Direction and time passes are focused checks, so their keys remain queued for a broader semantic review unless also covered by a main bilingual review group.
